target: Duel of Destiny

source: Duelo do Destino
target: Duel of Destiny

source: Duelo reavivado: Torneo regional de Lahai-Roi
target: Rekindled Duel: Lahai-Roi Regional Tournament

source: Dunkle Flammen in Stille
target: Dark Flames in Silence

source: Durch deine harte Arbeit haben bedeutende Veränderungen in Plüschtier-Dorf Wurzeln geschlagen. Inzwischen erhält das Dorf einen neuen Besucher ...
target: Through your hard work, meaningful changes have taken root in Plushie Village. In the meantime, the village receives a new visitor...

source: Durch deine harte Arbeit haben bedeutende Veränderungen in Plüschtier-Dorf Wurzeln geschlagen. Inzwischen erhält das Dorf einen neuen Besucher – eine Wanne Welpe.
target: Through your hard work, meaningful changes have taken root in Plushie Village. In the meantime, the village receives a new visitor—a Tubpup.

source: Durch einen Zufall kreuzen sich deine Wege erneut mit Jingran. Er scheint auf eine alte Angelegenheit gestoßen zu sein, in die die Unterweltwandler verstrickt sind.
target: You cross paths with Jingran again by chance, and he seems to have stumbled onto an old story involving the Nethermancers.

source: Dá para ouvir gritos por ajuda vindos da Cidade Portuária de Guixu. As vozes parecem tão familiares... É melhor ir verificar o que está acontecendo.
target: Intermittent cries for help can be heard from the Port City of Guixu. They sound oddly familiar. It's best to go check out what's happening.

source: Décoder les vœux corrompus : I
target: Decode corrupted wishes: I

source: Découvrir ce qui se passe après le spectacle de stand-up.
target: See what comes after the stand-up show

source: Découvrir où se trouvent les provisions du camp
target: Find out the whereabouts of the camp supplies

source: Défi de Crabe sans cloche multi-saveurs
target: Every Flavor Bell-less Crab Challenge

source: Défi du test d'amélioration de la Pointe de lance
target: Explosive Spear Tip Testing Challenge

source: Défi super méga giga !
target: The Super, Ultra, Extreme... Super Challenge!

source: Défi ultime
target: Ultimate Challenge

source: Dépenser 120 Fragments des ondes
target: Use 120 Waveplates in total

source: Dévoilez-vous, ceux dans l'ombre ou la lumière
target: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow

source: Día ideal para volar
target: A Perfect Day for Flying

source: Düsterer Wald
target: Dim Forest

source: Echo der Marche
target: Echoing Marche

source: Echos aus der Zerstörung
target: From the Echoes of Destruction

source: Eco humanoide dançante?
target: Dancing humanoid Echo?

source: Ecos Cerúleos à Deriva nos Ventos: Epílogo
target: Cerulean Echoes Adrift in the Winds: Epilogue

source: Ecos Cerúleos à Deriva nos Ventos: Parte I
target: Cerulean Echoes Adrift in the Winds: Part I

source: Ecos Cerúleos à Deriva nos Ventos: Parte II
target: Cerulean Echoes Adrift in the Winds: Part II

source: Ecos Persistentes
target: Lingering Echoes

source: Ecos persistentes
target: Lingering Echoes

source: Edelstein
target: Gem

source: Eh du dich versiehst, ist es bereits Zeit für Qingxiao, deine musikalischen Fortschritte zu prüfen ... Begib dich zum Innenhof am Zweigruh-Grat, um eure Verabredung einzuhalten.
target: Before you know it, it's time for Qingxiao to test how far your guqin playing has come. Head to the courtyard at Boughrest Ridge to keep the appointment.

source: Ehe die Skripte verbrennen und in Vergessenheit geraten, nimmt Phrolova den Edelstein aus Myas Helm.
target: Before the scripts burn and fade into oblivion, Phrolova takes the gem from Mya's helmet.

source: Ehrenkoch: Geschmack der Erinnerungen
target: Honorary Chef: Taste of Memories

source: Ein Bankangestellter mit nur zwei Händen?
target: Bank clerk showing only two hands?

source: Ein Bewohner namens Jianji sammelt im Namen der Stiftung Geld in der Stadt und verspricht Anlegern hohe Renditen. Das klingt nach einer guten Gelegenheit, reich zu werden …
target: A resident named Jianji is gathering funds in the city under a foundation's name, promising investors a remarkably handsome return. It sounds like a fine chance to get rich...

source: Ein Bewohner namens Jianji sammelt in der Stadt im Namen einer Stiftung Geld ein und verspricht den Investoren eine bemerkenswert hohe Rendite. Es klingt nach einer ausgezeichneten Gelegenheit, reich zu werden...
target: A resident named Jianji is gathering funds in the city under a foundation's name, promising investors a remarkably handsome return. It sounds like a fine chance to get rich...

source: Ein Diggy Duggy sendet dir eine Anfrage und hofft, dass du ihm hilfst, den Schatz zu finden, den es einst mit seinem jungen Meister vergraben hat.
target: A Diggy Duggy sends you a request, hoping you'll help find the treasure it once buried with its young master.

source: Ein Filmteam der Pioneer Association dreht Aufnahmen für eine Dokumentation und könnte dabei deine Hilfe gebrauchen.
target: A film crew from the Pioneer Association is shooting footage for a documentary, and they might just need your help.

source: Ein Forscher ist beim Sammeln von Vorräten in Schwierigkeiten geraten und scheint etwas Hilfe zu brauchen.
target: A researcher in charge of supplies is in trouble and needs help.

source: Ein Geschmack von Allem
target: A Taste of Everything

source: Ein Gratis-Mittagessen?
target: A Free Lunch?

source: Ein Handwerker namens Suoxi entwickelte auf Grundlage des Bergnagel-Pfahls eine neuartige Vorrichtung gegen Tacet-Dissonanzen: den „Anti-TD-Kinetikprojektor“. Derzeit werden Testpersonen gesucht.
target: An Artisan named Suoxi, using the Mountainpin as a prototype, has developed a new kind of anti-Tacet Discord device called the "Anti-TD Kinetic Stake," and is now recruiting testers.

source: Ein KI-Assistent zieht deine Aufmerksamkeit auf sich. Er erwähnt eine Strecke, die bisher noch niemand geschafft hat.
target: You've caught the attention of a particularly perceptive Terminal assistant. He claims there exists a race track where no one has ever crossed the finish line...

source: Ein Mann namens Ham lädt dich ein, am Spacetrek-Inkubationsprogramm teilzunehmen …
target: A man named Ham has invited you to participate in the Spacetrek Incubation Program...

source: Ein Musiker in Ragunna scheint von seinem Echo-Begleiter Malety beunruhigt zu sein ...
target: A musician in Ragunna City seems troubled by his Echo companion Melody...

source: Ein Mädchen namens Anita hat dich in den „Spitze des Ruhms“-Fanclub eingeladen. Von ihr erfährst du, dass dem Club derzeit die Auflösung droht …
target: A girl named Anita invites you into the Peaks of Prestige fan club. From her, you learn that the club is hanging by a thread...

source:
Ein Mädchen namens Dorothy erschien neben dem geheimnisvollen Tor.
Ihren Angaben zufolge brach jenseits des Tors plötzlich eine Krise aus.
target: A girl called Dorothy appears next to a mysterious gate. She claims a sudden crisis is taking place inside.

source: Ein Ofen in der Trattoria Margherita?
target: Oven at Trattoria Margherita?

source: Ein Satz sich ständig verändernder, rätselhafter Raumkoordinaten gerät unerwartet in euer Blickfeld. Ihrem Verlauf folgend, stößt du auf eine Stadt, die schon längst untergegangen ist ...
target: A pair of constantly shifting spatial coordinates leading to an unknown location has caught your attention. Following the trail, you reach a metropolis... that had been erased long ago.

source: Ein Schleier aus Nebel und Dunkelheit umhüllt das Moor und verbirgt die unerzählten Geschichten der Vergangenheit. Eine traurige Melodie hängt in der Luft und bietet Beileid für die Leben, die schon lange in die nächste Welt gereist sind.
target: A shroud of mist and gloom envelops the mire, concealing the untold tales of the past. A mournful melody lingers in the air, offering condolences to lives that have long journeyed to the next world.

source: Ein Seemann namens Starbuck ist in eine geistige Krise geraten – Gerüchten zufolge hat ihn ein Fisch in diesen Zustand getrieben ...
target: A sailor named Starbuck has fallen into mental turmoil—rumor has it, a fish drove him to this state...

source: Ein Seltsames Porträt im Montelli-Viertel?
target: Strange portrait in Montelli Quarter?

source: Ein Somnoire-Tor erscheint plötzlich in Lahai-Roi, und tief im Traumreich braut sich eine Krise zusammen …
target: The Somnoire gateway suddenly appears in Lahai-Roi, and deep within the Dream Abode, a crisis brews...

source: Ein Student aus Huanglong hat seine geliebte Katze mit an die Akademie gebracht. Doch sie liebt es offenbar ein wenig zu sehr, Verstecken zu spielen. Und heute beginnt schon die nächste Runde …
target: A Huanglong student has brought his beloved cat to the Academy. However, it seems the cat loves playing hide-and-seek. Today, it's starting a new round…

source: Ein Student der Abteilung für Leerenmaterie scheint eine unerwartete Entdeckung gemacht zu haben …
target: A student from the Department of Voidmatters appears to have made a new discovery...

source: Ein Teil des gemalten Turms leuchtet.
target: Some part of the painted tower is glowing.

source: Ein Wolkenshuttle im Di-Reich
target: On a Cloud Shuttle in the Di Realm

source: Ein Wunder geschieht?
target: A Free Meal?

source: Ein alter Einsiedler schreibt seine Memoiren in der Akademie. Er wünscht sich einige Bilder von Avinoleum.
target: An elderly hermit is writing his memoirs by the seminary ruins. He would like some images of Avinoleum.

source: Ein alter Kapitän namens Davide entscheidet sich, seine letzte Reise anzutreten. Doch dieses Mal ist es nicht das endlose, tosende Meer, das ihn ruft, sondern ein Ziel ...
target: An old captain named Davide is preparing for the last voyage of his life. But this time, his sights are set on something above the seas...

source: Ein entspannter Tag
target: A Chill Day Out

source: Ein fehlendes Jinhsi, ein rätselhafter Traum... Der „Wegfinder“, der dich an der Fähre erwartet, könnte dir die Antworten auf all diese Dinge geben.
target: Jinhsi has gone missing, and you just had an enigmatic dream.... That Wayfinder at the ferry may hold some answers to these mysteries.

source: Ein flauschiges Rezept
target: A Fluffy Prescription

source:
Ein geheimnisvoller Brief hebt sanft eine Ecke des Schleiers, der die vergangenen Nächte verhüllt.
Ein leises Flüstern aus den Tiefen des Abgrunds wartet auf deine Antwort.
target:
A mysterious letter gently lifts a corner of the veil that shrouds the nights gone by.
A faint whisper from the depths of the abyss waits for your reply.

source: Ein kleiner Septimontianer überreicht Mya einen Strauß Blutblatt-Schneebälle.
target: A small Septimontian hands Mya a bouquet of Bloodleaf Viburnum.

source: Ein kleines Boot, das wie ein Fisch aussieht?
target: Boat that looks like a fish?

source: Ein längst verstorbener Kapitän, ein Schiff, das nicht segeln kann. Und doch hat dieser Kapitän nun einen unvermeidlichen Kurs eingeschlagen und das Schiff muss wieder segeln ...
target: A long-dead captain, a ship that cannot sail. Yet now, that captain has set upon an inevitable course, and the ship must sail once again...

source: Ein neuer Auftrag taucht auf. Buling ist gezwungen, ihren Aufenthalt in Septimont zu verlängern.
target: New work comes up. Buling is forced to extend her stay in Septimont.

source: Ein neuer Gefährte
target: A New Companion

source: Ein nächtlicher Streifzug einer Straßenlampe
target: A Street Lighter's Night Walk

source: Ein paar Fische fangen
target: Go Get Some Fish

source: Ein paar vorsichtige Blicke aus der Ecke von Margheritas Restaurant ziehen offenbar deine Aufmerksamkeit auf sich. Schau vorbei, wenn du die Gelegenheit hast, und sieh dir das an.
target: A pair of cautious eyes from the corner of Margherita's restaurant seem to call for your attention. Drop by and take a look when you have the chance.

source: Ein perfekter Tag zum Fliegen
target: A Perfect Day for Flying

source: Ein riesiger Oktopus, der Instrumente spielt?
target: Octopus good at musical instruments?

source: Ein tanzendes Echo in menschlicher Gestalt?
target: Dancing humanoid Echo?

source: Ein unbezahlbares Paket wurde über den Ozean nach Ragunna verschickt. Es heißt, dass allein die Frachtversicherungsprämie eine Milliarde beträgt!
target: A priceless package has been shipped across the ocean to Ragunna. It is said that its freight insurance premium alone costs millions of credits!

source: Ein vergänglicher Nachttraum
target: A Fleeting Night's Dream

source: Ein vernachlässigter Straßenmaler sucht Hilfe. Geh und sieh selbst.
target: A neglected street painter is seeking help. Go and see for yourself.

source: Ein wahrer Arena-Champion
target: A True Arena Champion

source: Ein weinendes Mädchen
target: A crying girl

source: Eine Autopuppe wurde kürzlich zur Reparatur eingesandt, kann sich jedoch aufgrund einer Fehlkalibrierung nur noch rückwärts bewegen. Nun ist sie überraschend verschwunden …
target: An Autopuppet recently sent in for repair developed a part misalignment during calibration and can now only move in reverse. This faulty Autopuppet has wandered off by accident...

source: Eine Bestellung aus dem Kobaltblau
target: A Snowbound Order from Cobalt Blue

source: Eine Forscherin der Schwarzen Küsten wartet darauf, ihre neuesten Konzepte mit dir zu überprüfen.
target: The Black Shores' researcher is waiting for you to test out her new ideas.

source: Eine Gruppe Exilanten wurde plötzlich entdeckt. Geh und besiege sie.
target: A group of Exiles was suddenly found. Go and defeat them.

source: Eine Gruppe Puppen, die Musik machen?
target: Performing Plushies?

source: Eine Gruppe von Tacet-Dissonanzen ist in der Nähe der heißen Quelle aufgetaucht und stellt eine Bedrohung für die Sicherheit der Bewohner von Hongzhen dar. Besiege sie, bevor sie sich versammeln können.
target: A group of Tacet Discords has appeared near the hot spring, posing a threat to the safety of the residents of Hongzhen. Defeat them before they can form into a greater number.

source: Eine Gruppe von Tacet-Dissonanzen sammelt sich außerhalb von Hongzhen. Besiege sie, bevor sie die Stadt einnehmen.
target: A group of Tacet Discords are gathering on the outskirts of Hongzhen. Defeat them before they become a threat to the town.

source: Eine Gruppe von Tacet-Dissonanzen verseucht die Wasserquelle, die zum Wasserfall führt. Besiege sie, bevor sie irreparablen Schaden anrichten können.
target: A group of Tacet Discords are contaminating the water source leading to the waterfall. Defeat them before they can cause irreparable damage.

source: Eine Handvoll Exilanten streift durch die Wildnis. Geh und besiege sie.
target: A handful of Exiles are roaming around the wild. Go and defeat them.

source:
Eine Herausforderung namens „Mondschießen“ ist auf dem Mondlichtmarkt bekannt. Interessante Herausforderungen wie diese sind für Chixia... und dich gedacht!

Eine/einen Gefährtin/Gefährten wird nach Abschluss dieser Quest freigeschaltet
target:
A challenge called "Moon Shooter" is known at the Moonlit Fair. Interesting challenges like this are meant for Chixia... and you!

Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

source: Eine Lampe, deren Energie erschöpft ist?
target: Lantern out of power?

source: Eine Maske, die auf dem Dach singt?
target: Masks that sing on the rooftop?

source: Eine Nachricht erhalten. Sprich mit Lang'sheng.
target: You received a message. Talk to Langsheng.

source: Eine Nachricht von einem unbekannten Absender führt dich zur Welt des Paranormalen. Belege die Existenz oder Nichtexistenz dieser Phänomene und bringe schlüssige Beweise mit, um deine These zu begründen!
target: A WavesLine message from an anonymous sender draws you into a world of urban legends, unknowns, and anomalies. Investigate, record them, or verify, debunk them... Present evidence strong enough to speak for itself.

source: Eine Nacht unter funkelnden Sternen
target: A Night of Shimmering Stars

source: Eine Quest der Klugheit - I
target: A Quest of Wits - I

source: Eine Quest der Klugheit - II
target: A Quest of Wits - II

source: Eine Quest der Klugheit - III
target: A Quest of Wits - III

source: Eine Roya-Studentin scheint beim Transport ihrer Forschungsgeräte auf Schwierigkeiten gestoßen zu sein.
target: A Roya student seems to be having a hard time transporting her research equipment...

source: Eine WavesLine-Nachricht trifft ein, von einem seltsamen Account namens „Horizonte des Lichts“. Mit nahezu ansteckender Begeisterung lädt der Absender dich ein, an einer Fotografie-Veranstaltung „Lichtjäger-Sammlung“ teilzunehmen …
target: A WavesLine message arrives from a strange account named "Lightborne Horizons." With almost contagious enthusiasm, the sender invites you to join a photography event called "Light Chaser Collection"…

source: Eine WavesLine-Nachricht von Jingran ist eingetroffen. Begleite ihn, um dieser alten Unterweltwandler-Angelegenheit auf den Grund zu gehen.
target: A WavesLine message has come in from Jingran. Go with him and get to the bottom of this old Nethermancer story.

source: Eine bewegende Kamera der Pioneer Association?
target: Moving camera of the Pioneer Association?

source: Eine geheimnisvolle Person mit einer Maske taucht auf den Riccioli-Inseln auf. Er erscheint anmutig und elegant, doch in seiner Seele verbirgt sich etwas Wahnsinniges ...
target: A well-dressed mysterious person in a mask has appeared on Riccioli Island, but their odd demeanor doesn't match their refined attire.

source: Eine geheimnisvolle Tacet-Dissonanz ist aufgetaucht. Kräfte werden in der Hafenstadt Guixu benötigt, um sie zu besiegen.
target: A mysterious Tacet Discord has appeared. Forces are needed at Port City of Guixu to defeat it.

source: Eine kryptische Nachricht offenbart die Beteiligung der Séance-Gesellschaft an den Verschwinden in Jinzhou. Ist dies der Schlüssel zur Wahrheit?
target: A cryptic message reveals the Séance Society's involvement in Jinzhou's disappearances. Is this the key to unlocking the truth?

source: Eine kurze Ruhepause
target: A Brief Respite

source: Eine mysteriöse Badewanne über dem Wasserfall?
target: Mysterious bathtub on the top of a waterfall?

source: Eine riesige Schildkröte, die das Theater trägt?
target: Giant turtle carrying a theater?

source: Eine seltsame Forscherin versucht, mit Katzen durch eine spezielle Funktion ihres Terminals zu sprechen...
target: A strange researcher is trying to talk to cats through a special function of her Terminal...

source: Eine sich wandelnde Welt. Hier ruht Xuanfang
target: Nexus Unwound, Xuanfang Unveiled

source: Eine stille Partnerschaft
target: Tacit Partnership

source: Eine vertraute Stimme hallt durch die Frequenzen der Traumlandschaft und stellt sich als „Ebenholz-Torwächter“ vor. Du entscheidest dich, ihn zu suchen und herauszufinden, was er vorhat.
target: A familiar voice echoes through the dreamscape's frequencies, introducing himself as "Ebony Gatekeeper." You decide to seek him out and uncover what he's up to.

source: Einer bricht im Traum auf. Viele kehren aus dem Traum zurück.
target: One departs in the dream. Many return from the dream.

source: Einige Exilanten sind wieder in der Wildnis aufgetaucht. Geh und besiege sie.
target: Some Exiles showed up in the wild again. Go and defeat them.

source: Einige TDs streifen in der Nähe des vereinbarten Trainingsplatzes herum. Besiege sie alle.
target: Some TDs are roaming near the training spot you arranged with Faro. Take them out while you are there.

source: Einige Xuanfang-Wächter-Rekruten trainieren derzeit den gemeinsamen Kampf mit Autopuppen. Geh nachsehen, was dort vor sich geht.
target: Several new Xuanfang Warden recruits are undergoing training in combat coordination with Autopuppets. Go see what's happening.

source: Einige Zeit später ...
target: Some time later...

source: Einige Zeit zuvor
target: Some time before

source: Einige seltsame Sockel in der Wildnis wecken das Interesse des Forschers Qinggong und er möchte deine Hilfe bei diesem Problem.
target: Some strange pedestals in the wild pique Researcher Qinggong's interest and he wants your help over this issue.

source: Einsamer Pfad
target: Solitary Path

source: Einsamer Solisling
target: Lonely Soliskin

source: Eixos em Rotação, Eis Xuanfang
target: Nexus Unwound, Xuanfang Unveiled

source: El Comandante del Tiempo
target: The Commander of Time

source: El Departamento Rabelle parece estar reclutando participantes para un curso de combate virtual. Dirígete a la plataforma de entrenamiento para obtener más información.
target: The Rabelle College seems to be recruiting participants for a virtual combat course. Head to the training platform to learn more.

source: El Eco objetivo está al lado de la fuente en Piazza Libertad.
target: Head to the fountain in City Square for the target Echo

source: El Eco objetivo está al norte del distrito de Montelli.
target: Head to the north of the Montelli Quarter for the target Echo

source: El Eco objetivo está en las calles de Piazza Libertad.
target: Head to the street in City Square for the target Echo

source: El Eco objetivo está en lo alto de Piazza Libertad.
target: Head to the higher ground in City Square for the target Echo

source: El Eco objetivo está por el restaurante de la Calle del Banco.
target: Head to the restaurant on Bank Street for the target Echo

source: El Eco objetivo está por la orilla del río de Piazza Libertad.
target: Head to the riverbank in City Square for the target Echo

source: El Eco objetivo está por la orilla del río en el Elíseo de los Torpes.
target: Head to the shore in the Fool's Elysium for the target Echo

source: El Eco objetivo está por la orilla del río en el distrito de Montelli.
target: Head to the riverbank in the Montelli Quarter for the target Echo

source: El Equipo de Rescate de Gatitos encontró dificultades durante el proceso de rescate de gatos. Por favor, ayuda al equipo y lleva al gato callejero a Xiaoju.
target: The Kitty Rescue Team encountered difficulties during the process of rescuing cats. Please help the team and bring the stray cat to Xiaoju.

source: El Festival Eterno aún no termina, pero la Fiesta Lollo toca a su fin. Los momentos de alegría suelen ser breves, pero ante ellos se extiende un torrente estrellado.
target: The Forever Fest has yet to end, but the Lollo Party is already drawing to a close. Moments of joy never last long, but beyond them lies a brilliant river of stars.

source: El Ministerio de Fomento busca luchadores dispuestos a participar en pruebas de combate. Dirígete a la Pagoda Velobrumoso para echar un vistazo.
target: The Ministry of Development is looking for fighters willing to participate in combat tests. Head over near Fogveil Pagoda to take a look.

source: El Narrador del Teatro de Jinzhou está recogiendo estas páginas desgarradas. Ve y entrégaselas.
target: The Storyteller of Jinzhou Theater is collecting these torn pages. Go and deliver them to him.

source: El Narrador del Teatro de Jinzhou está recogiendo estas páginas rasgadas. Ve y entrégalas a él.
target: The Storyteller of Jinzhou Theater is collecting these torn pages. Go and deliver them to him.

source: El Narrador del Teatro de Jinzhou está recogiendo estos Chips de Datos. Ve y entrégalos a él.
target: The Storyteller of Jinzhou Theater is collecting these Data Chips. Go and deliver them to him.

source: El Narrador del Teatro de Jinzhou está recogiendo estos Chips de Datos. Ve y entrégaselos.
target: The Storyteller of Jinzhou Theater is collecting these Data Chips. Go and deliver them to him.

source: El Patrullero Chuyi en el Bosque Oscuro quiere pedirte que entregues una carta.
target: Patroller Chuyi in the Dim Forest would like your help delivering a letter.

source: El Patrullero cerca del Mar de Luciérnagas parece estar en problemas. Infórmate sobre la situación antes de que las cosas se pongan serias.
target: The Patrollers near the Fireflies Sea seems to be in trouble. Learn about the situation before things get serious.

source: El Portero de ébano te revela la causa de la anomalía en la Somnolencia. algo oculto en ese reino acecha siniestramente este mundo. Quizás esto no sea el final, sino el principio.
target: Ebony Gatekeeper tells you of an anomaly inside the Somnoire. Something lurking there is sinisterly gazing at this world. Perhaps this is not the end, but the beginning.

source:
El Puesto de abanicos de Dianxiao finalmente ha abierto, ve a echar un vistazo.

Desbloquea un nuevo compañero después de completar esta misión.
target:
Dianxiao is finally opening her Fan Drawing Stall. Go visit it.

Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

source: El Tesoro de Samousas
target: Samousas's Treasure

source: El Títere en retroceso
target: The Backward Autopuppet

source: El abrigo del hogar
target: The Comfort of Home

source: El abuelo Jingzhu finalmente revela el secreto definitivo para entrenar a los Ecos...! ¿Conseguirá finalmente lo que quiere esta vez?
target: Grandpa Jingzhu finally reveals the ultimate secret to training Echoes...! Will he finally get what he wants this time?

source: El abuelo Jingzhu ha ideado un nuevo método para entrenar Ecos. Ve y pregúntale sobre los detalles.
target: Grandpa Jingzhu has come up with a new method to train Echoes. Go and ask him about the details.

source: El amor en los tiempos de la pesca
target: Love in the Time of Fishing

source: El anciano que mira el cementerio desde la distancia espera rendir homenaje con las flores que sostiene a sus antiguos camaradas. Por favor, ayúdale a cumplir sus deseos.
target: The old man looking at the cemetery from a distance hopes to pay tribute with the flowers he holds to his past comrades. Please help him fulfill his wishes.

source: El artesano Suoxi ha creado un nuevo mecanismo para combatir las Disonancias Tácitas, inspirado en la Estaca Anclamontañas. Actualmente está reclutando voluntarios para probar su «Proyector Dinámico Anti-DT».
target: An Artisan named Suoxi, using the Mountainpin as a prototype, has developed a new kind of anti-Tacet Discord device called the "Anti-TD Kinetic Stake," and is now recruiting testers.

source: El asunto de Muyu ha llegado a un cierre temporal, pero la crisis de los Títeres rebeldes está lejos de terminar...
target: The matter of Muyu has come to a temporary close, but the crisis of the rogue Autopuppets is far from over...

source: El asunto de los nodos del sueño en la región de Raguna parece haber llegado a su fin por ahora. Ve a hablar con el gato blanco en la Ciudad de Raguna.
target: The dust of Ragunna's Dreamscape Nodes incident has settled for now. Go talk to the white cat in Ragunna City.

source: El barco amarrado
target: The Moored Boat

source: El camarero en la entrada de la casa de té está atrayendo a los clientes.
target: The Teahouse waiter is seeking customers at the entrance.

source: El campamento, que sufre de escasez de suministros, necesita desesperadamente suministros médicos...
target: The supply-starved camp is in desperate need of medical supplies…

source: El caos en Septimont se ha resuelto. Disfruta de este momento de respiro pacífico junto a tu compañera de viaje.
target: The turmoil in Septimont has been resolved. Enjoy the moment of peaceful respite with your fellow traveler.

source: El capitán llamado Davide finalmente se ha subido a la góndola y navega hacia el cielo, pero... ¿realmente este viaje será como él esperaba?
target: The captain named David has finally taken the Gondola to the skies, but will this voyage go as planned?

source: El cercado luminoso que está conteniendo a la Pezuña Férrea descontrolada no parece tecnología de roya, lo cual capta tu atención...
target: The Lightbeam Fencing restraining the rampaging Ironhoof doesn't seem like Royan tech, which captures your attention...

source: El comienzo de un mundo
target: Beginning of a World

source: El concierto eterno
target: The Eternal Concert

source: El contacto misterioso, las emboscadas de los Proscritos, el conductor con el que sigues encontrándote... todo finalmente está encajando.
target: The mysterious contact, the Outcast ambushes, the driver you keep running into… everything is finally coming together.

source: El contenido de la Campaña del día 1 se ha actualizado. Maji está listo para que te unas a él y asumas las nuevas tareas.
target: The Day 1 Campaign content has been updated. Maji is ready for you to join forces and take on the new tasks.

source: El contenido de la Campaña del día 2 se ha actualizado para incluir nuevas características de mantenimiento y navegación. ¡Prueba las nuevas funciones y observa cómo mejoran tu experiencia!
target: The Day 2 Campaign content has been updated to include new maintenance and navigation features. Test out the new functions and see how they enhance your experience!

source: El contenido de la Campaña del día 4 se ha actualizado. El mapa ahora muestra una posible amenaza en la ruta. Investiga el área y evalúa el peligro.
target: The Day 4 Campaign content has been updated. The map now indicates a potential threat along the route. Investigate the area and assess the danger.

source: El contenido de la Campaña del día 5 se ha actualizado, pero el mensajero enfrenta dificultades y solicita ayuda…
target: The Day 5 Campaign content has been updated, but a courier has encountered difficulties and is calling for help…

source: El corazón roto de Dimmr: desenlace
target: Broken Dimmr Heart: Finale

source: El dios hibernando espera silenciosamente a que llegue el peregrino. Distinguirán la verdad de la falsedad.
target: The hibernating deity silently awaits the pilgrims' arrival. To distinguish truth from lies, seek answers from this divine being.

source: El día 3 de la Campaña, la Navegación Lollo sufrió un inesperado fallo del sistema. Maji necesita tu ayuda para resolver el problema.
target: On Day 3 of the Campaign, Lollo Navigator suffered an unexpected system crash. Maji needs your help to resolve the issue.

source: El día del juicio final
target: Doomsday

source: El eco azul perdido en la brisa marina: Epílogo
target: Cerulean Echoes Adrift in the Winds: Epilogue

source: El eco azul perdido en la brisa marina: I
target: Cerulean Echoes Adrift in the Winds: Part I

source: El eco azul perdido en la brisa marina: II
target: Cerulean Echoes Adrift in the Winds: Part II

source: El ejército de Jinzhou quiere reiniciar el radar en las Tierras altas de Desoroca, pero el ingeniero a cargo aún no ha aparecido...
target: The Jinzhou military wants to restart the radar at Desorock Highland, but the engineer in charge has yet to show up...

source: El encargo de Langsheng
target: Langsheng's Request

source: El equipo de exploración del Bosque Oscuro ha enviado una señal de socorro urgente, contando con tu asistencia para abordar su problema urgente.
target: The Dim Forest survey team has sent an urgent distress signal, requesting your assistance with a pressing issue.

source: El estudio de las Profundidades de Dimmr ha alcanzado un punto crítico. Ayuda a los investigadores a recuperar la Geoaraña S4 que el Solistirpe Banana se llevó de paseo.
target: The surveying of the Dimmr Deep is at a critical juncture. Help the researchers recover their Geospider S4, which Soliskin Banana has taken for a joyride.

source: El faro en la Bahía Wuming ha perdido energía. ¡Intenta restaurar su funcionamiento!
target: The lighthouse at the Wuming Bay has lost power. Try to restore its power!

source: El gato de la dueña del restaurante Xiaoju no ha regresado. Por favor, ayuda a encontrar al gato travieso y devuélvelo a su dueño.
target: The cat of the restaurant owner Xiaoju has not returned. Please help find the naughty cat and bring it back to its owner.

source: El gato sospechoso de robar los gofres de Luuk está, temporalmente, bajo custodia. Dirígete a la enfermería y visítalo.
target: The cat suspected of stealing Luuk's waffles has been temporarily taken into his care. Head to the infirmary and visit it.

source: El hechizo de la felicidad
target: The Happiness Spell

source: El incidente se ha resuelto. Reúnete con Lynae en la fuente de la plaza.
target: The incident has been resolved. Accept Lynae's invitation and meet her at the square fountain.

source: El ingeniero Mizhi, siempre quejándose, siempre menciona que escucha un sonido misterioso que lo llama...
target: The nagging engineer Mizhi always mentions hearing a mysterious sound calling him...

source: El ingeniero está bloqueado por las Disonancias Tácitas en el camino al faro. ¡Acompáñala al faro!
target: Tacet Discords threaten the engineer on her way to the lighthouse. Provide her with escort.

source: El latido de la vida
target: The Heartbeat of Life

source: El límite entre la vida y la muerte
target: The Line Between Life and Death

source: El mar al alcance
target: The Sea Just Within Reach

source: El mar se ha calmado, pero el capitán Ahab y su tripulación han desaparecido. Ishmael, quien te llevó por primera vez a las Islas Riccioli, parece estar estudiando los restos dejados por el capitán…
target: The sea has calmed, but Captain Ahab and his crew are gone. Ishmael, who first brought you to the Riccioli Islands, seems to be studying the relics left behind by the legendary captain…

source: El negocio de Maji está expandiéndose rápidamente. Acaban de llegar nuevos mandados... ¿Un Eco necesita ayuda para buscar a alguien?
target: Maji's business is expanding rapidly. New errands just came in... An Echo needs help looking for someone?

source: El océano, refugio del alma
target: Ocean Is a Soul's Rest

source: El ominoso sonido que se desliza desde la niebla atrae a los marineros perdidos, llevándolos a la tierra de la muerte donde las Disonancias Tácitas corren desenfrenadas.
target: The ominous sound drifting from the fog lures the lost seafarers, drawing them into the land of death where Tacet Discords run wild.

source: El paradero del Títere Archivista
target: The Archival Autopuppet's Whereabouts

source: El pasado es el futuro: Continuado
target: The Past is the Future: Continued

source: El pasado es el futuro: Epílogo
target: The Past is the Future: Epilogue

source: El pasado es el futuro: Introducción
target: The Past is the Future: Introduction

source: El pasado, la memoria, el sueño... Muchas preguntas siguen sin respuesta sobre quién eres y quién eras. Sin embargo, algo parece invitarte a un refugio secreto lejos en el mar...
target: Your forgotten past, hazy memories, and a strange dream... So many questions linger about your identity, and who you used to be. Meanwhile, a mysterious pull guides you to a hidden place on the distant sea...

source: El paseo nocturno del farolero
target: A Street Lighter's Night Walk

source: El pintor preocupado ha perdido su antiguo vigor. Pregúntale por qué y ofrece tu ayuda.
target: The worried painter has lost his former vigor. Ask him why and offer your help.

source: El pintor ruega que le ayudes a atraer clientes. Trabaja en conjunto para avanzar en el plan.
target: The painter begs that you help him solicit customers. Work together to push forward the plan.

source: El primer intento de Yongxin terminó en un fiasco. ¿Tendrá éxito en su segundo intento?
target: Yongxin's first attempt ended tragically. Will a miracle arise on his second try?

source: El problema en el Bosque Oscuro finalmente ha sido resuelto, pero Qiaomu y Hoohoo todavía están alrededor del Baniano morado. Parecen particularmente interesados en las lunas del Baniano morado.
target: Following the events of the Dim Forest, Qiaomu and Hoohoo decided to stay around the Violet Banyan. They seem particularly interested in the moons of the Violet Banyan.

source: El programa de simulación de crisis de Tetis se ha actualizado. Con los nuevos datos recopilados en Costa Negra y Rinascita, ahora te esperan escenarios aún más extremos… solo para quienes se atrevan a enfrentarlos.
target: Tethys's crisis simulation program is getting an upgrade. With newly gathered data from the Black Shores and Rinascita, even harsher scenarios now await those who dare to face the challenge…

source: El progreso de la exploración de Monte Firmamento alcanza 30%.
target: Reach 30% Exploration Progress in Mt. Firmament

source: El proyector de Lucilla le está dando problemas, pero no tiene tiempo para encargarse de él. Échale una mano y arréglalo.
target: Lucilla's projector is malfunctioning, causing her some trouble. Due to her tight schedule, lend her a hand and fix it.

source: El próximo número del diario está en progreso. Ve a ver el contenido destacado.
target: The upcoming issue of the journal is in progress. Go and check out the featured content.

source: El ramo
target: Bouquet

source: El regalo de Platya
target: Platya's Gift

source: El regreso del resplandor
target: Radiance's Return

source: El rumor de un piano que no se ha tocado resonando en la lluvia parece haber atraído a muchas personas para ir a averiguar qué está pasando. Ve a investigar alrededor del teatro abandonado y descubre la verdad sobre este extraño suceso.
target: Rumors of sounds of a piano echoing in the rain seems to have attracted many curious visitors. Go investigate around the abandoned theater and find out the truth about this strange phenomenon.

source: El sistema de Maji recibe una solicitud de Canbañera, que pide tu ayuda para mejorar el servicio de baño.
target: Maji's system receives a request from a Tubpup who's asking for your help to upgrade the bathing service.

source: El stock de comida del gato se está agotando. Por favor, ayuda a alimentar al gato.
target: The Cat's food stock is running low. Please help feed the cat.

source: El sueño de Bakethoven es ingresar al depósito de Ecos de la Bóveda de Averardo. ¿Le echarías una mano?
target: Bakethoven's dream is to belong to the Echo Depository of Averardo Vault. Can you help him out?

source: El sueño de una noche fugaz
target: A Fleeting Night's Dream

source: El susurro de los recuerdos
target: The Whisper of Memories

source: El tan esperado Carnevale finalmente está por comenzar. Todos están listos para frustrar los planes de los Fractsidus durante la celebración...
target: The long-awaited Carnevale is finally set to begin. Together with your friends, you are ready to thwart the Fractsidus' schemes during the celebration...

source: El telón ha caído sobre las grandes competiciones. Ponte la medalla y continúa tu camino hacia el Valle de la Gloria, donde te espera una decisión capaz de cambiar el curso de la historia.
target: The curtain has fallen on the grand competitions. Don your medal and travel onward to the Vale of Glory, where you shall make a decision that may change how the story goes.

source: El tesoro del marinero
target: The Sailor's Treasure

source: El tesoro escondido de Costa Negra
target: The Hidden Treasure of the Black Shores

source: El tumulto en Septimont ha sido resuelto. Disfruta de la hermosa puesta de sol con tu compañera.
target: The turmoil in Septimont has been resolved. Enjoy the beautiful sunset with your companion.

source: El viejo y la ballena
target: Old Man and the Whale

source: El viento antes de la tormenta
target: The Wind Before the Storm

source: El último caballero
target: The Last Knight

source: El último combate
target: The Last Fight

source: Ele Lembra
target: It Remembers

source: Elegimos el cielo
target: We Choose the Sky

target: Eliminate the TDs

source: Elimine as DTs
target: Eliminate the TDs

target: Chasing the Moon, Here and Now

source: Em Jinzhou, você encontra um homem que parece angustiado. Ele afirma ter sobrevivido a um ataque misterioso...
target: In Jinzhou, you come across a man who appears to be distressed. He claims to have survived a mysterious attack…

source: Em Jinzhou, você encontra um… humano incomum?
target: In Jinzhou, you meet an unusual... human?

source: Em Septimont, você recebeu uma mensagem de Fulmine: "De alguma forma, um pequeno esquadrão de expedição de pelúcia de Ragunna chegou aqui também..."
target: In Septimont, you received a message from Fulmine: A tiny plushie expedition squad from Ragunna has somehow arrived here too…

source: Em busca da fé
target: Quest of Faith

source: Em busca da glória lunar
target: Chasing the Moon's Glory

source: Em meio a uma ondulação de Reverberações, você ouve o chamado… Enquanto desvenda seu passado um novo caminho se desdobra diante de você e acena do desconhecido.
target: Amidst a ripple of Reverberations, you hear the call... As you unravel your past, a new path unfolds before you, beckoning from the unknown.

source: Em nome da cavalaria I
target: In the Name of Chivalry I

source: Em nome da cavalaria II
target: In the Name of Chivalry II

source: Em nome da cavalaria III
target: In the Name of Chivalry III

target: In the Name of Chivalry V

target: In the Name of Chivalry VI

source: Em nome da cavalaria VII
target: In the Name of Chivalry VII

source: Em um vale marcado pela Maré Sombria, um velho Gladiador aguarda silenciosamente seu destino. Como uma espada antiga e enferrujada, ele sonha com glórias passadas.
target: In a valley scarred by the Dark Tide, an old Gladiator silently awaits his destiny. Like an ancient, rusted sword, he dreams of past glories.

source: Embora a promessa de compartilhar uma refeição ainda não tenha sido cumprida, agora pode ser um momento oportuno para se atualizar com ela. Se você não tiver outros assuntos urgentes, por que não marcar um encontro em Jinzhou?
target: Though the promise of sharing a meal has yet to be fulfilled, now could be an opportune moment to catch up with her. If you have no other pressing matters, why not arrange a meeting in Jinzhou?

source: Embora as cores não tenham forma
target: Although Colors Have No Form

source: Embora as cores não tenham forma: epílogo
target: Although Colors Have No Form: Epilogue

source: Emergência de Criatura do Vazio
target: Voidspawn Emergence

source: Emocionante Aventura da Encore!
target: Encore's Steaming Adventure!

source: Empreintes d'ailes
target: Imprints of Wings

source: Empreintes des Plateaux
target: Prints of Plateaus

source: Empreintes en terres givrées
target: Footprints on Frostlands

source: En Aldea Taoyuan, comienza la primera fase de la preparación festiva.
target: Begin the early-stage festival preparation at Taoyuan Vale

source: En Aldea Taoyuan, comienza la segunda fase de la preparación festiva.
target: Begin the second-stage festival preparation at Taoyuan Vale

source: En Aldea Taoyuan, comienza la tercera fase de la preparación festiva.
target: Begin the third-stage festival preparation at Taoyuan Vale

source: En Jinzhou te encuentras con un hombre que parece estar angustiado. Dice haber sobrevivido a un ataque misterioso…
target: In Jinzhou, you come across a man who appears to be distressed. He claims to have survived a mysterious attack…

source: En Jinzhou, te encuentras con un humano... ¿inusual?
target: In Jinzhou, you meet an unusual... human?

source: En Lahai-Roi, aparece sin previo aviso un portal de Somnolencia. En la Morada Onírica situada en sus profundidades, se gesta el peligro...
target: The Somnoire gateway suddenly appears in Lahai-Roi, and deep within the Dream Abode, a crisis brews...

source: En Septimont, recibiste un mensaje de Fulmine: Un Cuerpo de Exploració de Raguna también ha llegado aquí de alguna manera...
target: In Septimont, you received a message from Fulmine: A tiny plushie expedition squad from Ragunna has somehow arrived here too…

source: En busca de la gloria lunar
target: Chasing the Moon's Glory

source: En el Barranco Arcolapso, se forma un misterio. Trueno inicial, relámpagos, sonidos extraños y un «fantasma» que no se puede apagar... ¿Estás listo para descubrir la verdad?
target: In the Collapsed Arcbend Ravine, an urban legend takes shape. Strange sounds, and an inexplicable "ghost" that can't be shut down... On a rainy night, gather your courage and go take a look! Are you ready to uncover the truth?

source: En el Instituto de Investigación, te encuentras con dos investigadoras preocupadas. Parecen estar lidiando con un problema difícil…
target: At the Research Institute, you encounter two troubled researchers. They seem to be wrestling with a difficult problem…

source: En el campo de combate abandonado desde hace muchos años, recibes una grabación del pasado.
target: In the Squarefield, idle now for many years, you receive a recording from the past.

source:
En el desafío de Adivinanza se ha añadido un premio especial y exclusivo por tiempo limitado. ¡Únete rápidamente a Yangyang para participar en el desafío!

Completa esta misión para desbloquear un nuevo compañero.
target:
Riddle Twiddle is offering a limited special prize! Join Yangyang and try to win it!

Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

source: En el límite de los sueños
target: At Dream's Edge

source: En el pequeño cartucho de videojuegos se concentran múltiples sonidos, paisajes, historias y esperanzas. KU-Cass espera que le ayudes a recuperar los cartuchos perdidos para revivir las voces de la antigua civilización.
target: A small game cartridge could be a vessel of a captivating world of sounds, landscapes, lores, and inspirations... KU-Cass needs your assistance to recover the old game cartridges to listen again to the sounds of a lost past.

source:
En el pueblo de Egla, escuchas leyendas sobre lss «Ensoñaciones Nocturnas» y un «Caballero Demente». Decides investigar estas historias.

Esta área de misión guarda recompensas secretas por descubrir.
target:
In Egla Town, you hear legends of the "Night Reveries" and a "Mad Knight." You decide to investigate these stories.

Hidden rewards can be found in this area.

source: En la Academia, te encuentras con un estudiante que parece tener problemas con un robot TARD-E...
target: In the Academy, you come across a student who seems to be having trouble with a TARD-E Unit…

source:
En la Feria de la Luna hay un desafío llamado Tirador Lunar. Un desafío tan interesante, no podría faltar tú y Chixia.

Desbloquea un nuevo compañero después de completar esta misión.
target:
A challenge called "Moon Shooter" is known at the Moonlit Fair. Interesting challenges like this are meant for Chixia... and you!

Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

source: En la batalla de los Baldíos de Norfall, conseguiste impedir la eclosión del Ovatrax, salvando así a Jinzhou de la catástrofe. Sin embargo, bajo la aparente calma, la sombra de la guerra sigue acechando…
target: In the battle at the Norfall Barrens, you successfully prevented the hatching of the Ovathrax, sparing Jinzhou from disaster. Yet, beneath the veneer of peace, the shadow of war still lingers…

source: En la cima de las rocas arqueadas
target: Peak of the Arch-Shaped Rock

source: En la entrada de una sala sellada en el nivel inferior, un robot defectuoso sigue repitiendo instrucciones fragmentadas. Comunícate con él para descubrir la historia oculta dentro de esta sala.
target: At the entrance to a sealed room on the lower level, a malfunctioning robot keeps repeating fragmented instructions. Communicate with it to uncover the hidden story concealed within this room.

source: En la ladera, el Exiliado Yongli está rodeado de Cargas explosivas. Debido a tu impulso, todas las Cargas explosivas a su alrededor han detonado. Ve y escucha lo que tiene que decir.
target: On the hillside, Exile Yongli is surrounded by Explosive Charges. You detonated all of the charges out of impulse. Go listen to what he has to say.

source: En la naturaleza salvaje, un misterio toma forma. Un tren de medianoche, que dicen que está lleno de «fantasmas», corre sin cesar a través de la noche, hacia quién sabe dónde... ¿Es realmente como afirmó Mayo? ¡Reúne tu valor y ve a echar un vistazo!
target: Out in the wild, an urban legend takes shape. A Midnight Train, said to be packed with "ghosts," races endlessly through the night, toward who knows where... Is it truly as Mayo claimed? Gather your courage and go take a look!

source: En la pintura, una parte de la torre está brillando.
target: Some part of the painted tower is glowing.

source: En la sala de proyección encuentras a Lynae. ¿No estará faltando a clase de nuevo? Mejor será preguntarle en persona.
target: You run into Lynae in the Screening Room. Did she… skip classes again? Maybe you should ask her yourself.

source: En la tierra de Xuanfang, un escuadrón de Títeres sigue fallando una y otra vez en su habilitación de combate. Necesitan orientación.
target: In the Land of Xuanfang, a squad of feeble Autopuppets keeps losing fight after fight in their combat qualification. They could use some guidance.

source: En las Islas Riccioli aparece una persona misteriosa con máscara, vestida con elegancia, pero con una locura que contrasta con su apariencia.
target: A well-dressed mysterious person in a mask has appeared on Riccioli Island, but their odd demeanor doesn't match their refined attire.

source: En las Llanuras Solisemilla, Lyosroth está buscando al Solistirpe perdido…
target: On the Soliseed Plains, Lyosroth is searching for the missing Soliskin…

source: En los momentos finales, decides dejar la semilla de la esperanza en manos de Lupa.

source: La caja de Samousa fue arrastrada por la corriente. Para cumplir su sueño de infancia, te pide que la recuperes.
target: Samousas stash was washed downstream. To fulfill his childhood dream, he asks you to retrieve the lost box.

target: Maji's business is expanding rapidly. New errands just came in... An Echo needs help looking for someone?

source: La chercheuse du Littoral noir vous attend pour tester ses nouvelles idées.
target: The Black Shores' researcher is waiting for you to test out her new ideas.

source: La chica al final del teatro está buscando el regalo que su hermana le dejó, pero parece tener problemas para encontrarlo. Ve y averigua la situación.
target: The girl behind the theater seems to have trouble looking for the gift her sister left her. Go and learn about the situation.

source: La cita de una comida con mi pareja aún no se ha cumplido, así que parece que es hora de encontrarme con ella adecuadamente... Si no sucede nada más, ¿por qué no vuelves a la ciudad y lo compruebas?
target: Though the promise of sharing a meal has yet to be fulfilled, now could be an opportune moment to catch up with her. If you have no other pressing matters, why not arrange a meeting in Jinzhou?

source: La compétition est terminée, portez la médaille, allez au Val glorieux et faites le choix qui peut changer l'histoire.
target: The curtain has fallen on the grand competitions. Don your medal and travel onward to the Vale of Glory, where you shall make a decision that may change how the story goes.

source: La crise a été passée, mais pour Rinascita, le chemin est encore long...
target: The crisis is over, but Rinascita still has a long road ahead of it…

source: La crise de Xuanfang désormais apaisée, une silhouette inconnue apparaît dans le village de Xianling... Lié à cette terre par un passé vieux d'un siècle, il revient enfin dans un pays qu'il n'a pourtant jamais connu.
target: With Xuanfang's crisis at rest, an unfamiliar figure steps into Xianling Village... Bound to this land by a century-old past, he finally returns to homeland he has never known...

source: La crise des Ateliers célestes touche enfin à sa fin, et Danjin a trouvé sa voie. Un chemin périlleux, certes, mais avec la lumière qui palpite dans son jade et tes paroles au fond de son cœur, elle n'appréhende plus ce qui l'attend.
target: The Crisis at the Skyworks has come to an end, and Danjin has found her path. It is a treacherous one, but with the light pulsating in her jade pendant and your words in her heart, she no longer fears what lies ahead.

source: La crise des automates s'arrange et tout semblait s'être calmé dans les Terres de Xuanfang...
target: Following the Autopuppet crisis, all seemed to have settled down in the Land of Xuanfang...

source: La crisis en la Factoría Celeste ha llegado a su fin y Danji ha encontrado su camino. Es un camino lleno de peligros, pero con la luz que palpita en su colgante de jade y tus palabras grabadas en su corazón, ya no teme lo que le depare el futuro.
target: The Crisis at the Skyworks has come to an end, and Danjin has found her path. It is a treacherous one, but with the light pulsating in her jade pendant and your words in her heart, she no longer fears what lies ahead.

source: La desaparición del Jardín.
target: The Garden's disappearance

source: La directrice Lucilla vous présente Grahame, un étudiant de l'Académie. Elle vous confie la mission de l'escorter lors de son « voyage de fin d'études » dans les Plaines de Dimmr...
target: President Lucilla introduces you to a student named Grahame. She tasks you with joining him on a "graduation trip" to the Dimmr Plains...

source: La disparition du Jardin
target: The Garden's disappearance

source: La divinité dormante attend silencieusement - c'est le moment d'affronter l'être suprême pour découvrir la vérité.
target: The hibernating deity silently awaits the pilgrims' arrival. To distinguish truth from lies, seek answers from this divine being.

source: La divinité qui commande le temps, la divinité qui apporte des bénédictions. Il est maintenant temps de les affronter.
target: It is the deity that commands time. It is the deity that bestows blessings. Now is your time to confront Sentinel Jué.

source: Nach der Schlacht von Norfall Barren, kam alles zu einem Ende. Deine Freunde rufen dich zu einem Treffen mit Snacks im Panhua Restaurant. Es scheint, sie möchten mehr über das "Kleine" in deinem Körper erfahren...
target: After the battle of Norfall Barren, everything came to an end. Your friends are calling you for a meet-up with snacks at Panhua's Restaurant. It seems they like to know more about that "little one" from within your body...

source: Nach einer Weile erhältst du eine Nachricht von Tulia. Die beiden Papyomen, die du gerettet hast, sind in der Nähe der Grenzberge aufgetaucht. Sie ist schon dort ... Du solltest sofort hingehen.
target: After a while, you receive a message from Tulia. The two Scourgewings you rescued have appeared near Border Mountains. She's already there... Better not make them wait.

source: Nach einer kleinen Wendung auf der Reise heißt Ragunna, die Stadt der Echos, den Reisenden von fernen Küsten herzlich willkommen.
target: After a minor twist in the journey, Ragunna, the Land of Echoes, unfolds its grandeur, extending a grand welcome to the traveler from distant shores.

source: Nach einer langen Phase harter Arbeit hat Lucilla endlich Zeit, sich zu entspannen und einen Film mit dir zu schauen. Nimm ihre Einladung an und genieße diesen ruhigen Moment zusammen.
target: After a long stretch of busy work, Lucilla has finally found time to relax and watch a film with you. Accept Lucilla's invitation and enjoy this peaceful moment together.

source: Nach einer langen Reise ist die Plüschtiere-Bande ganz durcheinander ... Hilf ihnen, sich wieder aufzufrischen und glänzend sauber zu werden.
target: After a long journey, the plushie squad is a mess… Let's help them freshen up and get sparkling clean again.

source: Nach langer Zeit hat KU-Crash erneut eine Einladung zum Test der Virtuellen Krise geschickt. Daher machst du dich auf den Weg zu den Schwarzen Küsten ...
target: After a long time, KU-Cage has once again sent an invitation to test the Virtual Crisis, and so you set off for the Black Shores...

source: Nachdem Denia verschwunden ist, bittet Arman dich ins Forschungsinstitut, um etwas über sie zu besprechen.
target: Now that Denia's gone missing, Arman invites you to discuss something about her at the Research Institute.

source: Nachdem Platya erfahren hat, dass die Legendäre Miko möglicherweise mit der Sondereinsatzgruppe in Verbindung steht, bittet sie dich, bei I.R.I.S. nachzufragen, während sie selbst weiterhin auf dem Campus nach Hinweisen sucht.
target: After hearing that the "Lady Miko" might have ties to the Special Response Force, she asks you to consult I.R.I.S. while she continues to gather intel around campus.

source: Nachdem Platyas Geschenk endlich fertig ist, fällt dir ein, dass nur Lucilla Kontakt zur Miko hat. Du beschließt, sie zu bitten, das Geschenk für Platya zu überreichen.
target: With Platya's gift finally finished, you think of the one person in contact with the "Lady Miko," Lucilla. You decide to ask her to deliver it on Platya's behalf.

source: Nachdem der Vorfall in der Dunklen Seite beendet ist, trifft sich Lucilla mit Hiyuki in der Aula. Lucilla vermutet, dass die Fractsidus im Hintergrund einen weitaus größeren Plan verfolgen …
target: After the Dark Side incident comes to an end, Lucilla meets with Hiyuki at the auditorium. Lucilla suspects that the Fractsidus may be plotting something far more dangerous behind the scenes…

source: Nachdem die Bedrohung der Dunklen Flut für Ragunna gebannt ist, bereitest du dich darauf vor, nach Septimont aufzubrechen.
target: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

source: Nachdem die Ereignisse in Lahai-Roi vorüber sind ... kehrt Hiyuki in die Stadt Honami zurück. Schließlich muss sie die letzte Läuterung vollenden.
target: With the events of Lahai-Roi over... Hiyuki returns to Honami. After all, she must complete the final Purge.

source: Nachdem die Feier begonnen hat, schickt dir Lynae eine neue WavesLine-Nachricht. Nimm ihre Einladung an und komm mit ihr zum Mittagessen.
target: After the Celebration begins, Lynae sends you a new WavesLine message. Accept her invitation and join her for lunch.

source: Nachdem die Krise der Autopuppen beendet war, lud die Huaxu-Akademie Yangyang zu einer erneuten Spektralanalyse ein. Während sie auf das Ergebnis wartete, suchte sie die geheimnisvolle Stimme erneut heim …
target: After the Autopuppet crisis was resolved, the Huaxu Academy invites Yangyang to undergo another Spectrum examination. However, as Yangyang awaited the results, that mysterious voice finds its way to her once more...

source: Nachdem du Margheritas Anruf angenommen hast, entschließt du dich, den letzten Tag der Kampagne gemeinsam mit Bakie zu kochen.
target: After taking Margherita's call, you decide to spend the last day of the campaign cooking with Bakie.

source: Nachdem du den Hinweisen gefolgt bist, entdeckst du den Raum, der angeblich verborgene Schätze birgt. Doch es scheint ein ganz gewöhnlicher Raum zu sein …
target: After following the clues, you discover the room said to conceal hidden treasures. Yet, it appears to be just an ordinary room…

source: Nachdem du die Datensammlung für Arno abgeschlossen hast, erhältst du eine Nachricht von ihm, die ein Treffen in Jinzhou anfordert.
target: Having finished the data collection for Arno, you receive a message from him requesting a meeting in Jinzhou.

source: Nachdem du die Krise mit dem Prototypen im Zwielichtwald gelöst hast, erhältst du eine anonyme Nachricht und gehst zum Forschungsinstitut des Spacetrek-Kollektivs.
target: After resolving the crisis with the prototype in the Twilight Woodlands, you head to the Spacetrek Collective's Research Institute at the request of an anonymous message.

source: Nachdem du die TD-Ausbruchskrise gelöst hast, bist du mit Jiyan nach Jinzhou zurückgekehrt ...
target: After resolving the crisis of TD outbreak, you and Jiyan returned to Jinzhou...

source: Nachdem sich Qingyan erholt hat, scheint ihn noch etwas zu beschäftigen. Geh nach ihm sehen …
target: Qingyan seems to have a few things on his mind now that he's recovered. Go see what they are...

source: Nachdem sich die Lage in Xuanfang vorerst beruhigt hat, erscheint im Dorf Xianling eine fremde Gestalt ... Mit einer über hundert Jahre währenden Geschichte im Gepäck betritt er zum ersten Mal diese ihm unbekannte Heimat ...
target: With Xuanfang's crisis at rest, an unfamiliar figure steps into Xianling Village... Bound to this land by a century-old past, he finally returns to homeland he has never known...

source: Nachdem sie nach deinen Vorlieben gefragt hat, könnte Lelia dich dieses Mal mit etwas wirklich Besonderem überraschen. Besuche Margheritas Restaurant und finde es heraus.
target: Having asked about your preferences, Lelia might surprise you with something truly special this time. Visit Margherita's restaurant and find out.

source: Nachgeschichte
target: Afterstory

source: Nachglühen
target: Afterglow

source: Nachricht in der Flasche
target: Message in a Bottle

source: Nahe der Übertragungsstation ist ein fremder Roya-Händler aufgetaucht. Er zeigt sich dir gegenüber ungewöhnlich herzlich und scheint dich zu einem merkwürdigen Handel einladen zu wollen …
target: A strange Royan merchant arrives near the Relay Station, unusually warm and eager to involve you in an odd transaction…

source: Nahe der Übertragungsstation ist ein fremder Roya-Händler aufgetaucht. Er zeigt sich dir gegenüber ungewöhnlich herzlich und scheint dich zu einer merkwürdigen Transaktion einladen zu wollen …
target: A strange Royan merchant arrives near the Relay Station, unusually warm and eager to involve you in an odd transaction…

source: Namipon, das eigentlich in Honami bleiben sollte, ist plötzlich in der Sternenfackel-Akademie aufgetaucht. Es hat etwas sehr Wichtiges mit dir zu besprechen …
target: Namipon, who was supposed to remain in Honami City, has suddenly appeared at Startorch Academy. It needs to discuss something very important with you...

source: Namipon, que deveria permanecer na Cidade de Honami, apareceu de repente na Academia Tochestrela. Precisa discutir algo muito importante com você...
target: Namipon, who was supposed to remain in Honami City, has suddenly appeared at Startorch Academy. It needs to discuss something very important with you...

source: Namipon, qui était censé rester à Honami, est soudainement apparu à l'Académie Brandétoile. Il semble avoir quelque chose d'important à vous dire...
target: Namipon, who was supposed to remain in Honami City, has suddenly appeared at Startorch Academy. It needs to discuss something very important with you...

source: Namipon-Suche – Letzte Verbeugung
target: Namipon Search - The Last Bow

source: Namipón, quien se supone que debía permanecer en Honami, ha aparecido repentinamente en la Academia Fuegostelar. Necesita decirte algo muy importante...
target: Namipon, who was supposed to remain in Honami City, has suddenly appeared at Startorch Academy. It needs to discuss something very important with you...

source: Nas Planícies de Semente Solar, Lyosroth está procurando pelo Solispírito desaparecido...
target: On the Soliseed Plains, Lyosroth is searching for the missing Soliskin…

source: Navegador Lollo está atualmente em manutenção e precisa de informações de referência. Alguns dos itens que você coletou podem ajudar Maji a resolver esse problema…
target: Lollo Navigator is currently undergoing maintenance and needs reference information. Some of the items you've collected might help Maji resolve the issue…

source: Ne se laissant pas abattre par ses échecs passés, Lelia s'est lancée dans sa prochaine tentative.
target: Not one to dwell on past failures, Lelia has thrown herself into her next attempt.

source: Nebel, Foyers und die verborgene Hand
target: Fog, Foyers, and the Hidden Hand

source: Nebelschleier-Pagode
target: Fogveil Pagoda

source:
Neben dem mysteriösen Morph-Gemälde erweckst du das in einen Albtraum verstrickte Mädchen, die Malerin Claudia.
Claudia bittet dich, ihr zu helfen, die Welt innerhalb des Gemäldes zu erkunden, und schenkt dir ein Amulett zur Unterstützung.
target:
Beside a mysterious morph painting, you find a painter named Claudia, trapped in her nightmares.
Claudia asks you to investigate the world within the painting and gives you a protective talisman.

source: Nebengeschichte
target: Side Story

source: Nebenquests
target: Side Quests

source: Necesitas autorización para activar el Constructor de rutas y ayudar al Observatorio Intergaláctico a reconstruir la red de rutas. Habla con Chonglin, quien está a cargo de la red de rutas, y consigue la autorización.
target: You need clearance to activate the Route Constructor and help the Spacetrek Observatory reconstruct the route network. Talk to Chonglin, who is in charge of the route network, and acquire clearance.

source: Nem todos os tesouros do mar foram deixados por piratas, alguns podem ter sido deixados por marinheiros comuns... ou um capitão.
target: Not all treasure of the sea is left behind by pirates, some could have been left by ordinary sailors... or a captain.

source: Neu Entfacht: Lahai-Roi-Liga
target: Rekindled Duel: Lahai-Roi Regional Tournament

source: Neustart des Smartprint-Würfels: Frostlande-Oberfläche
target: Smartprint Cube Reboot - Frostlands Surface

source: Nicht jeder, der einen Schatz ins Meer verbirgt, ist ein räuberischer Pirat. Es könnte auch ein gewöhnlicher Seemann oder ein Kapitän sein.
target: Not all treasure of the sea is left behind by pirates, some could have been left by ordinary sailors... or a captain.

source: Nicht weit entfernt scheint ein Jagdlager überfallen worden zu sein. Sieh nach, was dort passiert ist.
target: It seems like the nearby hunting camp was attacked. Go check it out.

source: Nicht weit von Yumyum Haven triffst du auf Zhezhi, die Probleme hat, Inspiration für ihre Gemälde zu finden. Frage sie danach.
target: Not far away from Yumyum Haven, you meet Zhezhi, who is troubled by a lack of inspiration for her paintings. Ask her about it.

source: Nieblas, vestíbulos y aquella persona tras el telón
target: Fog, Foyers, and the Hidden Hand

source: Niveau de la Banque des données atteint 18
target: Upgrade Data Bank to Lv. 18

source: Niveau de la Banque des données atteint 21
target: Upgrade Data Bank to Lv. 21

source: Niveau de la Banque des données atteint 24
target: Upgrade Data Bank to Lv. 24

source: No Desfiladeiro Curvado Colapsado, uma lenda urbana toma forma. Há sons estranhos e um "fantasma" inexplicável que não pode ser desligado... Em uma noite chuvosa, tome coragem e dê uma olhada! Você quer descobrir a verdade?
target: In the Collapsed Arcbend Ravine, an urban legend takes shape. Strange sounds, and an inexplicable "ghost" that can't be shut down... On a rainy night, gather your courage and go take a look! Are you ready to uncover the truth?

source: No Instituto de Pesquisa, você encontra dois pesquisadores perturbados. Eles parecem estar preocupados com um problema difícil...
target: At the Research Institute, you encounter two troubled researchers. They seem to be wrestling with a difficult problem…

source: No Limiar das Lâminas
target: Clashing Blades

source: No Recinto, ocioso agora por muitos anos, você recebe uma gravação do passado.
target: In the Squarefield, idle now for many years, you receive a recording from the past.

source: No Sopé da "Montanha das Cinco Raposas"
target: At the Foot of Five-Fox Mountain

source: No caminho para o Pavilhão da Névoa Velada
target: On the way to the Fogveil Pagoda

source: No dia 3 da campanha, o navegador Lollo sofreu uma falha inesperada no sistema. Maji precisa da sua ajuda para resolver o problema.
target: On Day 3 of the Campaign, Lollo Navigator suffered an unexpected system crash. Maji needs your help to resolve the issue.

source: No fim da sua aventura, você descobre que a Aldeia Pelúcia ainda guarda mais uma surpresa.
target: As your adventure comes to an end, you learn that the Plushie Village still has another surprise waiting for you.

source: No hay respuesta esta noche
target: No Response Tonight

source: No se sabe si Jingran ha mejorado. Ve a visitarlo.
target: There's no telling whether Jingran is doing any better. Go pay him a visit.

source: No todos los que dejan tesoros en el mar son piratas, también podría ser un simple marinero... o un capitán.
target: Not all treasure of the sea is left behind by pirates, some could have been left by ordinary sailors... or a captain.

source: Non loin du Havre de Yumyum, vous rencontrez Zhezhi, qui est troublée par un manque d'inspiration pour ses peintures. Demandez-lui à ce sujet.
target: Not far away from Yumyum Haven, you meet Zhezhi, who is troubled by a lack of inspiration for her paintings. Ask her about it.

source: Nos momentos finais, você decide deixar Lupa com a semente da esperança.
target: In the final moments, you decide to leave Lupa with the seed of hope.

source: Nossa história está apenas começando!
target: Our Story Has Only Just Begun!

source: Notiere die Frequenz des TD
target: Record the TD's frequency

source: Nous choisissons le ciel
target: We Choose the Sky

source: Nuances de combat
target: Shades of Battle

source: Nuestro encuentro bajo el cielo
target: When the Sky Watches Us Meet

source: Nuevo trabajo aparece. Buling se ve obligada a extender su estancia en Septimont.
target: New work comes up. Buling is forced to extend her stay in Septimont.

source: Num dia comum, você encontra um jovem em perigo… e assim começa a história de um cavaleiro.
target: On an ordinary day, you come across a young man in danger... And so begins the tale of a knight.

source: Numa ilha em um lago ao redor da Vila Arco-Íris, uma geatuga parece ter um conflito com outras Dissonâncias Transgressoras... As Dissonâncias Transgressoras competem entre si?
target: On an island in a lake around Hongzhen, a Hoartoise seems to have a conflict with other Tacet Discords... Do Tacet Discords lock horns?

source: Nun ist der Sturm vorüber – lasst uns erneut feiern.
target: Now the storm has passed, let us celebrate again.

source: Nun ruht die Siegesmedaille auf deiner Brust.
target: Now the medal of victory rests upon your chest.

source: Nur ich überlebte
target: I Alone Survived

source: Não muito longe do Aconchego do Sabor, você encontra Zhezhi, que está preocupada com a falta de inspiração para suas pinturas. Pergunte a ela sobre isso.
target: Not far away from Yumyum Haven, you meet Zhezhi, who is troubled by a lack of inspiration for her paintings. Ask her about it.

source: Não se sabe se Jingran está melhor. Vá visitá-lo.
target: There's no telling whether Jingran is doing any better. Go pay him a visit.

source: Névoa, Salão e Alguém entre as Cortinas
target: Fog, Foyers, and the Hidden Hand

source: O Abismo de Chenshu era originalmente uma prisão para DTs, mas vozes de vivos podem ser ouvidas de dentro...
target: The Sunken Warren was originally a prison for Tacet Discords, but voices of the living can be heard from deep within...

source: O Abismo de Chenshu é uma vasta instalação para deter e descartar DTs, não é lugar para pessoas comuns vagarem por perto. No entanto, ao explorá-lo, você ouve o som de alguém pedindo ajuda...
target: The Sunken Warren is a vast facility for detaining and disposing of Tacet Discords, no place for ordinary folk to wander near. Yet while exploring it, you catch the sound of someone crying out for help...

source: O Amanhã É Tão Distante Quanto o Brilho
target: Tomorrow Is As Far As the Shimmer

source: O Barco Ancorado
target: The Moored Boat

source: O Cercado de Feixe de Luz que contém o Casco de Ferro descontrolado não parece ser tecnologia royana, o que chama sua atenção...
target: The Lightbeam Fencing restraining the rampaging Ironhoof doesn't seem like Royan tech, which captures your attention...

source: O Conforto do Lar
target: The Comfort of Home

source: O Desafio "Estandartes Nunca Caem" está prestes a terminar. Gladiador corajoso, é hora de reivindicar sua glória!
target: The "Banners Never Fall" Challenges is about to end. Brave Gladiator, it's time to claim your glory!

source: O Descanso da Final
target: Finale's Respite

source: O Despertar de um Sonho
target: Waking from a Dream

source: O Eco das Cordas: Primeira Corda
target: The Strings Remember: First String

source: O Eco das Cordas: Quarta Corda
target: The Strings Remember: Fourth String

target: The Strings Remember: Fifth String

target: The Strings Remember: Second String

target: The Strings Remember: Sixth String
