target: The Strings Remember: Seventh String

source: O Eco das Cordas: Terceira Corda
target: The Strings Remember: Third String

source: O Escritório da Rede de Rotas Lahai-Roi emitiu um alerta, e a atividade dos Proscritos mencionada desperta seu interesse...
target: The Lahai-Roi Route Network Office has issued an alert, and the Outcast activity it mentioned captures your interest…

source: O Feitiço da Felicidade
target: The Happiness Spell

source: O Festival Eterno ainda não chegou ao fim, mas a Grupo Lollo já está se encerrando. Momentos de alegria nunca duram muito, mas além deles há um rio brilhante de estrelas.
target: The Forever Fest has yet to end, but the Lollo Party is already drawing to a close. Moments of joy never last long, but beyond them lies a brilliant river of stars.

source: O Fractiverso montou um acampamento para uma força de ataque e pretendem usá-lo como trampolim para outra invasão visando o Monte Firmamento. Não lhes dê nenhuma chance.
target: The Fractsidus has set up a camp for a strike force and intends to use it as a stepping stone for another invasion aimed at Mt. Firmament. Don't give them any chances.

source: O Guardião de Ébano conta sobre uma anomalia dentro de Sonúmia. Algo à espreita observa este mundo de forma sinistra. Talvez este não seja o fim, mas o começo.
target: Ebony Gatekeeper tells you of an anomaly inside the Somnoire. Something lurking there is sinisterly gazing at this world. Perhaps this is not the end, but the beginning.

source: O Maquinete Invertido
target: The Backward Autopuppet

source: O Mar ao Alcance
target: The Sea Just Within Reach

source:
O Mercado das Iguarias está realizando sua liquidação anual, e você e Abby decidem dar uma olhada.
Lá, vocês encontram Suisui e passam um dia despreocupado juntos.
target:
Huizhen Plaza is holding its annual sale, and you and Abby set out to take a look.
There, you run into Suisui and spend a carefree day together.

source: O Mercado das Iguarias está realizando sua venda anual, e você e Abby saem para dar uma olhada.
target: The Huizhen Plaza is holding its annual sale, and you and Abby set out to take a look.

source: O Ministério do Desenvolvimento está procurando lutadores dispostos a participar de testes de combate. Vá para perto do Pavilhão da Névoa Velada para dar uma olhada.
target: The Ministry of Development is looking for fighters willing to participate in combat tests. Head over near Fogveil Pagoda to take a look.

source: O Oficina Celeste
target: The Skyworks

source: O Paradeiro do Maquinete de Arquivo
target: The Archival Autopuppet's Whereabouts

source: O Passado Retornará
target: The Bygone Shall Always Return

source: O Pelotão de Pelúcia está preso em uma crise criativa e precisa da sua ajuda. Você decide tirá-los dessa situação.
target: The Plushie Squad is stuck in a creative slump and needs your help. You decide to get them out of it.

source: O Pesquisador Resgatado
target: The Rescued Researcher

source: O Pistoleiro Supremo!
target: The Supreme Gunslinger!

source: O Presente e o Futuro
target: The Present and the Future

source: O Pulso da Vida
target: The Heartbeat of Life

source: O Sussurro das Memórias
target: The Whisper of Memories

source: O Tesouro do Marinheiro
target: The Sailor's Treasure

source:
O Tio Dong encontrou um tesouro deixado por uma pessoa antiga. Isso pode se tornar uma atração imperdível de sua barraca, “A Lua me Contou”.

Desbloqueie um novo companheiro após concluir esta missão.
target:
Uncle Dong has found a treasure left by an ancient person. This could prove to be a must-see of his stall, "Thus Says the Moon".

Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

source: O Velho e a Baleia
target: Old Man and the Whale

source: O Vermelho Flamejante do Amanhã
target: The Flaming Red from Tomorrow

source: O acampamento privado de suprimentos precisa desesperadamente de suprimentos médicos...
target: The supply-starved camp is in desperate need of medical supplies…

source: O assunto de Muyu chegou a um fim temporário, mas a crise dos Maquinetes rebeldes está longe de acabar...
target: The matter of Muyu has come to a temporary close, but the crisis of the rogue Autopuppets is far from over...

source: O caos em Septimont foi resolvido. A jovem que te ofereceu ajuda saiu de férias.
target: The turmoil in Septimont has been resolved. The young lady who offered you help is now on vacation.

source: O caos em Septimont foi resolvido. Aproveite o belo pôr do sol com sua companhia.
target: The turmoil in Septimont has been resolved. Enjoy the beautiful sunset with your companion.

source: O caos em Septimont foi resolvido. Aproveite o momento de descanso em paz com sua companhia de viagem.
target: The turmoil in Septimont has been resolved. Enjoy the moment of peaceful respite with your fellow traveler.

source: O capitão chamado Davide finalmente levou a gôndola aos céus, mas será que esta viagem sairá como planejado?
target: The captain named David has finally taken the Gondola to the skies, but will this voyage go as planned?

source: O comandante do tempo
target: The Commander of Time

source: O concerto eterno
target: The Eternal Concert

source: O contador de histórias do Teatro de Jinzhou está coletando essas páginas rasgadas. Vá e entregue-as a ele.
target: The Storyteller of Jinzhou Theater is collecting these torn pages. Go and deliver them to him.

source: O contador de histórias do Teatro de Jinzhou está coletando esses Chips de Dados. Vá e entregue-os a ele.
target: The Storyteller of Jinzhou Theater is collecting these Data Chips. Go and deliver them to him.

source: O contato misterioso, as emboscadas dos Proscritos, o motorista que aparece sempre... tudo finalmente está se encaixando.
target: The mysterious contact, the Outcast ambushes, the driver you keep running into… everything is finally coming together.

source: O conteúdo da campanha do dia 2 foi atualizado para incluir novos recursos de manutenção e navegação. Teste as novas funções e veja como elas melhoram sua experiência!
target: The Day 2 Campaign content has been updated to include new maintenance and navigation features. Test out the new functions and see how they enhance your experience!

source: O conteúdo da campanha do dia 4 foi atualizado. O mapa agora indica uma ameaça potencial ao longo da rota. Investigue a área e avalie o perigo.
target: The Day 4 Campaign content has been updated. The map now indicates a potential threat along the route. Investigate the area and assess the danger.

source: O conteúdo da campanha do dia 5 foi atualizado, mas um mensageiro encontrou dificuldades e está pedindo ajuda…
target: The Day 5 Campaign content has been updated, but a courier has encountered difficulties and is calling for help…

source: O conteúdo do dia 1 da campanha foi atualizado. Maji está pronto para você se juntar e assumir novas tarefas.
target: The Day 1 Campaign content has been updated. Maji is ready for you to join forces and take on the new tasks.

source: O cão de Yingye, Maocai, tem desaparecido todas as tardes ultimamente. Siga Maocai e veja para onde ele vai à tarde.
target: Yingye's dog Maocai has been disappearing every afternoon lately. Follow Maocai and see where it goes in the afternoons.

source: O desaparecimento do Jardim
target: The Garden's disappearance

source: O engenheiro irritante Mizhi sempre menciona ouvir um som misterioso chamando por ele…
target: The nagging engineer Mizhi always mentions hearing a mysterious sound calling him...

source: O esconderijo de Samousas foi levado rio abaixo pela correnteza. Para realizar seu sonho de infância, ele pede que você recupere a caixa perdida.
target: Samousas stash was washed downstream. To fulfill his childhood dream, he asks you to retrieve the lost box.

source: O estoque de comida do gato está acabando. Ajude a alimentar o gato.
target: The Cat's food stock is running low. Please help feed the cat.

source: O farol na Baía Wuming perdeu energia. Tente restaurar a energia!
target: The lighthouse at the Wuming Bay has lost power. Try to restore its power!

source: O filme de viagem está chegando ao fim, e a jornada de vocês juntos realmente a deixou feliz e satisfeita.
target: The road trip movie is nearing its end, and your journey together has truly made her happy and content.

source: O garçom da casa de chá está procurando clientes na entrada.
target: The Teahouse waiter is seeking customers at the entrance.

source: O gato da dona do restaurante Xiaoju não voltou. Ajude a encontrar o gato travesso e trazê-lo de volta à dona.

A challenge called "Moon Shooter" is known at the Moonlit Fair. Interesting challenges like this are meant for Chixia... and you!

target: To find the Exostrider and uncover the truth behind your frequency loss, you step into the falling snow and venture toward the silent, pale expanse of the frostlands.

source: Um ein besonderes Universitätsprojekt abzuschließen, ist Zenus allein in die Dimmr-Ebene aufgebrochen …
target: To complete a special school project, Zenus entered the Dimmr Plains alone...

source: Um eine Förderung zu beantragen, haben Ronan und seine Kollegen jeweils einen Forschungsantrag eingereicht. Kannst du erraten, welcher schließlich genehmigt wird?
target: To apply for funding, Ronan and his colleagues have each submitted a research proposal. Can you guess which one ends up getting approved?

target: A resident named Jianji is gathering funds in the city under a foundation's name, promising investors a remarkably handsome return. It sounds like a fine chance to get rich...

target: You've caught the attention of a particularly perceptive Terminal assistant. He claims there exists a race track where no one has ever crossed the finish line...

source: Você coletou algumas “caixas de sonância”. Parece interessar ao Chenpi, o comerciante local de relíquias.
target: You've collected some "Sonance Caskets". It seems to fall in the interest of the local Relic Merchant Chenpi.

source: Você concordou com Zhuo Shanyue em ajudar a recuperar os Maquinetes. Se encontrar um Maquinete rebelde, você pode intervir para recuperá-lo primeiro e depois informar Zhuo Shanyue sobre o local...
target: You agreed with Zhuo Shanyue to help recover the Autopuppets. If you encounter a rogue Autopuppet, you may step in to retrieve it first and then inform Zhuo Shanyue of the location...

source: Você concordou em ajudar Zhenliu e pegou o pacote pequeno, mas pesado. Vá encontrar a pessoa a quem ele se destina.
target: You agreed to help Zhenliu and took the small but heavy package. Go find the person it's meant for.

source: Você concordou em aprender guqin com Qingxiao. Vá até o salão de treinamento dela para começar a próxima fase das suas lições.
target: You've agreed to learn the guqin from Qingxiao. Head to her training hall to begin the next lesson.

source: Você conhece um estudante animado chamado Bjarki. Graças às recomendações dele, você quer saber mais sobre os diferentes "fã-clubes" da Academia...
target: You meet an enthusiastic student named Bjarki. Thanks to his recommendations, you find yourself intrigued by all the different "fan clubs" across the Academy…

source: Você cruza caminhos com a gladiadora Lupa em Septimont.
target: You cross paths with Gladiator Lupa in Septimont.

source: Você descobriu o propósito e as direções das três fichas, mas as respostas para seus enigmas estão escondidas atrás de uma entrada misteriosa, que você encontrou com a ajuda das dicas do Relógio de Sol.
target: You have discovered the three tokens' purpose and directions, but the answers to their riddles are hidden behind a mysterious entrance, which you found with help from the Sundial's hints.

source: Você descobriu uma moto de expedição no desfiladeiro gelado... Encontre uma maneira de trazê-la de volta para a Ascensão Estelar.
target: You've discovered an expedition motorbike in the ice gorge... Find a way to bring it back to the Starward Riseway.

source: Você e Cartethyia lutam lado a lado em uma batalha que ninguém vê.
target: You and Cartethyia fight side by side in a battle no one sees.

source: Você e as pelúcias viajam acima das nuvens, onde um mundo de maravilhas os espera.
target: You and the plushies journey above the clouds, where a world of wonder awaits your discovery.

source: Você encontra Jingran novamente por acaso, e ele parece ter esbarrado em um antigo caso envolvendo os Inframantes.
target: A WavesLine message has come in from Jingran. Go with him and get to the bottom of this old Nethermancer story.

source: Você encontra Jingran novamente por acaso, e ele parece ter esbarrado em um antigo caso envolvendo os Inframantes.
target: You cross paths with Jingran again by chance, and he seems to have stumbled onto an old story involving the Nethermancers.

source: Você encontra Lenore, uma acólita da Ordem, ao lado de um Maschera d’Aria. Ela parece estar em apuros…
target: You run into Lenore, an acolyte of the Order, standing next to an Aria Mummer. She seems to be in trouble...

source: Você encontra Lynae na Sala de Exibição. Será que ela... matou aula de novo? Talvez você devesse perguntar para ela.
target: You run into Lynae in the Screening Room. Did she… skip classes again? Maybe you should ask her yourself.

source: Você encontra Maji mais uma vez. Recém-chegado da sede da Logística Lollo, ele parece determinado a relançar a Campanha Lollo.
target: You cross paths with Maji once more. Fresh from the Lollo Logistics Headquarters, he appears determined to relaunch the Lollo Campaign.

source: Você encontra Maji, da Logística Lollo, em Ragunna. Que nova campanha ele está planejando?
target: You meet Maji from Lollo Logistics in Ragunna. What new campaign is he planning?

source: Você encontra Xiangli Yao novamente sob a Árvore dos Desejos. No entanto, desta vez vocês compartilham uma caminhada não pelos desejos dos outros, mas pela glória da lua e pelas vidas agitadas das pessoas.
target: You meet Xiangli Yao again under the Wishing Tree. Yet, this time you share a walk not for others' wishes but for the moon's glory and the bustling lives of people.

source: Você encontra Xuanyin novamente, enquanto os sons de sapos te cercam…
target: You meet Xuanyin again, while the sounds of frog surround you...

source: Você encontra Xuanyin novamente, que estava imersa em pensamentos…
target: You meet Xuanyin again, who was buried in thoughts...

source: Você encontra Xuanyin novamente, que está se divertindo com alguns filhotes…
target: You meet Xuanyin again, who is having fun with some puppies...

source: Você encontra Xuanyin novamente. Desta vez, ela está espionando o Tetra…
target: You meet Xuanyin again. This time, she is spying on the Tetra...

source: Você encontra Xuanyin novamente. Desta vez, ela está espionando um Coelho-verde…
target: You meet Xuanyin again. This time, she is spying on a Green Rabbit...

source: Você encontra Xuanyin novamente. Desta vez, ela está observando as pombas no telhado…
target: You meet Xuanyin again. This time, she is observing the doves on the rooftop...

source: Você encontra Xuanyin novamente. Desta vez, ela está tentando falar com uma Gaivota-de-crista-cinza…
target: You meet Xuanyin again. This time, she is trying to talk to a Gray Crested Gull...

source: Você encontra crianças brincando de esconde-esconde. Elas prometem seu "tesouro" se você conseguir encontrar todas elas no tempo estipulado...
target: You come across kids playing hide-and-seek. They promise you their “treasure” if you can find all of them within the time limit…

source: Você encontra um holograma deixado por um pesquisador. Parece que ele está convidando você para experimentar a "obra-prima" da qual tanto se orgulha.
target: You come across a hologram left behind by a researcher. It seems he's inviting you to try out the "masterpiece" he's so proud of.

source: Você encontra um pesquisador ansioso que está procurando por um lote de TARD-Es perdidos nas Planícies de Dimmr...
target: You encounter an anxious researcher who is searching for a batch of lost TARD-Es in the Dimmr Plains...

source: Você encontra um robô incomum que parece ter uma visão bastante única da verdade por trás deste mundo...
target: You encounter an unusual robot who seems to hold a rather unique view of the truth behind this world...

source: Você encontra um velho contador de histórias enquanto vagueia pela Vila Arco-Íris. Enquanto ouve os contos de imortalidade sobre o Monte Firmamento, você percebe outro ouvinte interessado...
target: You meet an old storyteller when you roam about in Hongzhen. While you listen to the the immortality tales about Mt. Firmament, you notice another interested listener...

source: Você encontra uma dupla estranha na Floresta Obscura. Eles parecem ter perguntas peculiares para você. Responda corretamente às perguntas deles e você pode receber algumas recompensas.
target: You meet a strange dual in the Dim Forest. They seem to have peculiar questions for you. Answer their questions correctly, and you might receive some rewards.

source: Você encontra uma misteriosa "centelha de luz". Siga essa pequena centelha e poderá testemunhar as estrelas cadentes arderem.
target: You find a mysterious "light spark." Follow this little spark, and you may witness the shooting stars blaze.

source: Você encontra uma misteriosa "faísca de luz". Siga essa pequena centelha e poderá testemunhar as estrelas cadentes arderem.
target: You find a mysterious "light spark." Follow this little spark, and you might witness the shooting stars blaze.

source: Você encontra uma multidão em um canto peculiar de Jinzhou. Que tal dar uma olhada?
target: You find a crowd in a peculiar corner of Jinzhou. Why not go and check it out?

source: Você encontra uma senhora idosa em Ermos de Asfódelo. Ela contempla as frequências fugazes à distância em busca de um companheiro perdido que jamais poderá retornar...
target: You meet an old lady in the Asphodel Barrens. She gazes at the fleeting frequencies off into the distance in search of a lost companion who can never return...

source: Você encontrou algumas estátuas peculiares nas Planícies de Dimmr. Elas parecem estar guardando um segredo oculto...
target: You've found some peculiar statues in the Dimmr Plains. They seem to be guarding a hidden secret...

source: Você encontrou outro gato de rua. Resgate-o e leve-o para Xiaoju.
target: You find another stray cat. Please rescue it and bring it to Xiaoju.

source: Você encontrou um Exilado atacado por Dissonâncias Transgressoras. Após testemunhar suas capacidades, ele busca sua ajuda.
target: You encountered an Exile attacked by Tacet Discords. After witnessing your capabilities, he seeks for you aid.

source: Você encontrou um pesquisador ansioso, que solicita sua ajuda para afastar os Mico-Chefes.
target: You encountered an anxious researcher, who requests your help to fight off the Hoochiefs.

source: Você entrega o "tesouro" tomado das crianças para I.R.I.S. A análise do sistema revela que está conectado a um professor desaparecido. Você decide investigar mais a fundo.
target: You hand the “treasure” taken from the kids to I.R.I.S. The system analysis reveals it's connected to a missing professor. You decide to look deeper.

source: Você fez um acordo com Jin: se o Academia Huaxu de Xuanfang precisar de mais materiais medicinais no futuro, ela entrará em contato com você por mensagem para comissioná-lo para a coleta.
target: You made an arrangement with Jin: if the Xuanfang Huaxu Academy needs more medicinal materials in the future, she will contact you via message to commission you for the gathering.

source: Você fica sabendo de uma lenda urbana sobre uma "Miko Fantasma Amante de Filmes" no chat em grupo da Academia. Você decide ir até a sala de projeção para investigar.
target: You catch wind of a “Film-Loving Ghost Miko” urban legend in the Academy's group chat. You decide to head to the screening room to check it out.

source: Você frustrou os planos vis do Fractiverso no Monte Firmamento, mas suas forças remanescentes ainda estão ativas perto das ruínas da Serra do Dragão. Derrote-os antes que possam causar mais danos.
target: You foiled the Fractsidus' vile plans at Mt. Firmament, but their remnant forces are still active near the ruins of Loong's Ridge. Defeat them before they can cause more harm.

source: Você investiu no alicerce de que Jianji falou, mas será que realmente verá os retornos que ele prometeu?
target: You've invested in the foundation Jianji spoke of, but will you really see the returns he promised?

source: Você localizou o mecha de patrulha desaparecido. Vá até a região selvagem e recupere-o.
target: You've located the missing patrol mech. Head into the wilderness and retrieve it.

source: Você marcou de tocar um dueto com Qingxiao hoje. Vá até aquele pavilhão familiar perto do Ministério da Guerra. Ela está esperando por você.
target: You've agreed to play a duet with Qingxiao today. Head to that familiar pavilion near the Ministry of War. She's waiting for you.

source: Você obteve um objeto estranho de Chenpi, que insinuou ser uma chave para um segredo há muito esquecido.
target: You obtained a strange object from Chenpi, who implied it was a key to a long-forgotten secret.

source: Você obteve um veículo. Siga as instruções do WavesLine e vá ao Terminal de Treinamento para concluir o tutorial de pilotagem de veículos.
target: You've obtained a vehicle. Please follow the WavesLine instructions and go to the Training Terminal to complete vehicle driving tutorial.

source: Você pegou uma gravação. O vento está uivando em seus ouvidos, carregando os sussurros. Talvez, o robô próximo detenha a chave para desvendar a continuação da história.
target: You've picked up a recording. The wind is howling in your ears, carrying the whispers. Perhaps, the robot nearby holds the key to unravel the continuation of the story.

source: Você pode pescar mais do que apenas peixes quando estiver no mar...
target: You may catch more than just fish when out at sea...

source: Você precisa de autorização para ativar o Construtor de Rotas e ajudar o Observatório Sideral a reconstruir a rede de rotas. Fale com Chonglin, que está encarregado da rede, e obtenha a autorização.
target: You need clearance to activate the Route Constructor and help the Spacetrek Observatory reconstruct the route network. Talk to Chonglin, who is in charge of the route network, and acquire clearance.

source: Você recebe um folheto da Associação dos Pioneiros na sua caixa de correio. Vá até a filial de Jinzhou e pergunte a Maqi o que aconteceu.
target: You receive a Pioneer Association Leaflet in your mailbox. Go to Jinzhou Branch and ask Maqi what has happened.

source: Você recebe uma ligação de Fulmine, a quem algumas "pessoas" misteriosas pediram para te mandar um convite...
target: You receive a call from Fulmine, who was asked by a few mysterious "people" to send you an invitation...

source: Você recebe uma mensagem de Encore, dizendo que obteve algo super incrível e divertido, e que está animada para compartilhar com você. O que poderia ser?
target: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

source: Você recebe uma mensagem de Lucilla solicitando sua presença no escritório da Secretaria Acadêmica para discutir os planos. No lugar da ocupada reitora, Hiyuki se encontrará com você.
target: You receive word from Lucilla requesting your presence at the Academic Affairs office to discuss plans. In place of the busy President, Hiyuki will be meeting with you.

source: Você recebe uma mensagem enviada por engano: Ronan afirma ter testemunhado a "evolução milagrosa de um Baiacrona" e animadamente convida você para ver...
target: You receive a mis-sent message: Ronan claims to have witnessed the "miraculous evolution of a Kronapuff" and excitedly invites you to see it…

source: Você recebe uma mensagem no WavesLine pedindo ajuda. Verifique do que se trata.
target: You receive a WavesLine message asking for help. Check what it's about.

source: Você recebe uma mensagem urgente da Academia Huaxu para suporte de emergência. Dirija-se ao local designado para mais informações.
target: You receive an urgent message from Huaxu Academy for emergency support. Head to the designated location for more information.

source: Você recebeu um contato dos Guardiões de Marfim e Ébano. Algo deve ter acontecido com Sonúmia.
target: You received a contact from the Ivory and Ebony Gatekeepers. Something must've happened with the Somnoire.

source: Você recebeu um convite para uma festa de tiro peculiar, aparentemente relacionada ao robô danificado em Serra do Assentamento. Vá conferir.
target: You've received an invitation to a peculiar shooting party, seemingly related to the damaged robot in Settle Range. Go check it out.

source: Você recebeu uma carta de convite de Wenshu. Ela menciona que os “Jogos Ribeirinhos de Jinzhou” serão realizados em breve. Vá para as coordenadas anexadas na carta e dê uma olhada.
target: You have received an invitation letter from Wenshu. It mentions that the"Jinzhou Riverside Games" will be held soon. Go to the coordinates enclosed in the letter and have a look.

source: Você recebeu uma mensagem do gato branco de Sonúmia. Vá falar com ele na Cidade de Ragunna.
target: You received a message from the white cat of the Somnoire. Go talk to it in Ragunna City.

source: Você recebeu uma mensagem no WavesLine de um remetente desconhecido
target: You received a WavesLine message from an unknown sender

source: Você recebeu uma mensagem. Fale com Langsheng.
target: You received a message. Talk to Langsheng.

source: Você recebeu uma nova mensagem do Covil do Caçador: examine os rastros deixados pelas DTs e vá atrás deles.
target: You receive a new message from the Hunter's Den: Please examine the traces left by TDs and track them down.

source: Você recebeu uma tarefa de Jinzhou. O quê? Farinha em Ragunna custa apenas metade do preço de Jinzhou?!
target: You received an errand from Jinzhou. What? Flour in Ragunna only costs half as much as in Jinzhou?!

source: Você resgata Jianji e descobre que todo o caso foi obra de Exilados que se infiltraram em Xuanfang. Você recupera os fundos e, com a ajuda do Pavilhão da Passagem, devolve-os às vítimas.
target: You rescue Jianji and discover the whole affair was the work of Exiles who had slipped into Xuanfang Hold. You recover the funds and, with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' help, return them to the victims.

source: Você resgatou muitos gatos de rua. Vá ao Restaurante de Xiaoju para ver como eles estão.
target: You've rescued many stray cats. Please go to Xiaoju's Restaurant to see how they are doing.

source: Você resgatou um Maschera d’Aria ferido perto da Cidade de Septimont. Ele te confia quatro Caixas de Melodia, cada uma carregando uma peça musical. Que história elas poderão contar?
target: You rescued a weak Aria Mummer near Septimont City. It entrusts you with four Melody Boxes, each carrying a piece of music. What story might they tell?

source: Você retorna a Ragunna para ver se as consequências do Fabricatório das Profundezas afetaram as pessoas de lá, mas inesperadamente encontra Zani na cidade. Já que está aqui, vale a pena conversar com ela para se atualizar sobre a situação.
target: You return to Ragunna to see whether the aftermath of the Fabricatorium of the Deep reached the people there, but unexpectedly run into Zani in the city. Might as well talk to her to catch up with the situation.

source: Você se envolve no projeto de reconstrução do Observatório Sideral ajudando a reconstruir a rede de rotas de Lahai-Roi.
target: You get involved in the reconstruction project of the Spacetrek Observatory by helping rebuild Lahai-Roi's route network.

source: Você se recusou a ajudar Zhenliu, mas ainda concordou em entregar o pacote e a lista ao seu destino. Vá encontrar o destinatário.
target: You declined to help Zhenliu, but still agreed to deliver the package and the list to their destination. Go find the recipient.

source:
Você se vê em meio a uma aposta entre Brant e a tripulação e, antes que possa protestar, o título de capitão por um dia da Trupe dos Tolos recai sobre você.
Vamos lá, Capitão? A aventura aguarda!
target:
You find yourself caught in a gamble between Brant and the crew, and before you can protest, the title of one-day captain of the Fool's Troupe is thrust upon you.
Are you ready, Captain? Adventure awaits!

source: Você tem um novo pedido da “Consertos Lollo”. Conclua-o a tempo.
target: You have a new "Lollo Fixit" order. Please fulfill it in time.

source: Você tem um novo pedido de “Compras de Mercearia Lollo”. Conclua-o a tempo.
target: You have a new "Lollo Grocery Shopping" order. Please fulfill it in time.

source: Você tem um novo pedido de “Escoltas Lollo”. Conclua-o a tempo.
target: You have a new "Lollo Hitman" order. Please fulfill it in time.

source: Você tem um novo pedido “Carinhos Lollo”. Conclua-o a tempo.
target: You have a new "Lollo Petter" order. Please fulfill it in time.

source: Você tem um novo pedido “Comedor Lollo”. Conclua-o a tempo.
target: You have a new "Lollo Eater" order. Please fulfill it in time.

source: Você tem um novo pedido “Marmitex Lollo”. Conclua-o a tempo.
target: You have a new "Lollo Take-in" order. Please fulfill it in time.

source: Você testemunha um crime à meia-noite. Para sua surpresa, uma figura familiar aparece na cena...
target: You witness a crime at the stroke of midnight. To your surprise, a familiar figure appears at the scene...

source: Você vê Pan-hua confortando uma menina chorando. Talvez deva se aproximar e perguntar o que aconteceu...
target: You see Panhua comforting a crying girl. Maybe go up and ask what happened...

source: Voe no Ritmo
target: Soar to the Beat

source: Voeu du Mime
target: Mummer's Wish

source: Voix de la Matière du néant
target: Sound of Voidmatter

source: Vollgas voraus! Sternenfackel-Racing!
target: Rev It Up! Startorch Race!

source: Vollgas! Tempo & Blitz!
target: Full Throttle! Bolt & Blitz!

source: Volta do Coração Selvagem
target: Wild Heart's Return

source: Volta do coração selvagem
target: Wild Heart's Return

source: Von den Tiefen der See
target: From the Depths of the Sea

source: Von der Dämmerung bis zur Nacht
target: From Dusk 'Til Darkness Falls

source: Vor Eros Zelt liegt ein Haufen seltsamer Dinge, die scheinbar aus dem Nichts aufgetaucht sind. Ist das einfach nur ein Durcheinander oder der Auftakt zu etwas Größerem? Geh zu Ero und finde heraus, was dahinter steckt.
target: In front of Ero's tent, a pile of mysterious objects has appeared out of nowhere. Is this a troublesome mess or the beginning of a story? Go talk to Ero and find out what's going on.

source: Vor der Spielhalle Seelenflug winkt dir eine Studentin namens Tetoris, um das neueste Spiel des Jahres auszuprobieren: Lahai-Roi-Blöcke. Das Spiel soll viele wundersame Eigenschaften haben, zumindest behauptet sie das …
target: Outside the Mind Dive Arcade, a student named Tetoris beckons you to try the latest "Game of the Year," Lahai-Roi Blocks. The game has many wondrous properties, or so she claims...

source: Vorsicht besser als Nachsicht
target: Better Safe Than Sorry

source: Votre Borne a capté des signaux flous. Peut-être que le Nexus pourra vous aider à en décrypter le contenu.
target: Your Terminal has received vague signals. Maybe the Nexus Beacon can help you decipher the information contained within.

source: Votre Borne a capté à nouveau des signaux flous. Peut-être que le Nexus pourra vous aider à en décrypter le contenu.
target: Your Terminal has received similar signals again. Maybe the Nexus Beacon can help you decipher the information contained within.

source: Votre vieil ami Maji jure avoir trouvé sa chance à Septimont avec, encore une fois, l'une de ses idées d'affaires de « génie ». Mais qu'elle décolle ou s'écroule dépend de votre aide.
target: Your old friend Maji swears he's found his break in Septimont with yet another one of his "genius" business ideas. But whether it takes off or crashes depends on your help.

source: Vou Te Mostrar o Mecha
target: I'll Show You the Mech

source: Vous aidez Fratellino à résoudre tous ses problèmes, et il souhaite vous remercier en personne.
target: You helped Fratellino resolve all his troubles, and he wants to thank you in person.

source: Vous aidez Fratello à passer tous les défis, et il souhaite vous remercier en personne.
target: You helped Fratello complete all his trials, and he wants to thank you in person.

source: Vous aidez Fratellone à résoudre tous ses problèmes, et il souhaite vous remercier en personne.
target: You helped Fratellone resolve all his troubles, and he wants to thank you in person.

source: Vous aidez Timoteo à récupérer ses fonds volés. L'affaire est réglée, sa tristesse se dissolvant comme des larmes dans la neige.
target: You help Timoteo recover his stolen funds. The incident comes to an end, his sorrow melting away like tears in the snow.

source:
Vous apprenez la fête « Rêveries nocturnes » de la ville d'Egla et décidez de voir par vous-même le légendaire « Chevalier Fou ».

Explorez la zone de la quête pour obtenir les récompenses cachées
target:
In Egla Town, you hear legends of the "Night Reveries" and a "Mad Knight." You decide to investigate these stories.

Hidden rewards can be found in this area.

source: Vous avez accepté d'aider Zhenliu et avez pris le petit paquet important. Allez trouver la personne à qui il est destiné.
target: You agreed to help Zhenliu and took the small but heavy package. Go find the person it's meant for.

source: Vous avez accepté d'aider Zhuo Shanyue à récupérer les automates. Si vous rencontrez un automate rebelle, vous pouvez intervenir pour le récupérer d'abord, puis informer Zhuo Shanyue de l'emplacement...
target: You agreed with Zhuo Shanyue to help recover the Autopuppets. If you encounter a rogue Autopuppet, you may step in to retrieve it first and then inform Zhuo Shanyue of the location...

source: Vous avez accepté d'apprendre le guqin auprès de Qingxiao. Rendez-vous à sa salle d'entraînement pour commencer la prochaine étape de vos leçons.
target: You've agreed to learn the guqin from Qingxiao. Head to her training hall to begin the next lesson.

source: Vous avez aidé les trois frères, et ils souhaitent vous remercier en personne.
target: You helped the three brothers with their respective troubles, and they want to thank you in person.

source: Vous avez aidé une étudiante nommée Ang à trouver le guide d'observation des étoiles dont elle avait besoin. Apparemment, ce guide a une signification particulière pour elle, car il est lié à un pacte entre amies…
target: You helped a student named Ang recover her stargazing guide. To her, it's more than just a booklet; it carries the weight of a promise she shared with her friends…

source: Vous avez conclu un accord avec Jin : si l'Académie de Huaxu de Xuanfang a besoin de plus de matériaux médicinaux à l'avenir, elle vous contactera par message pour vous charger de la collecte.
target: You made an arrangement with Jin: if the Xuanfang Huaxu Academy needs more medicinal materials in the future, she will contact you via message to commission you for the gathering.

source: Vous avez convenu de jouer un duo avec Qingxiao aujourd'hui. Retrouvez-la au pavillon près du Ministère des Armées, elle vous y attend.
target: You've agreed to play a duet with Qingxiao today. Head to that familiar pavilion near the Ministry of War. She's waiting for you.

source: Vous avez croisé un Exilé attaqué par les Tacet Discords. Après avoir constaté vos capacités, il sollicite votre aide.
target: You encountered an Exile attacked by Tacet Discords. After witnessing your capabilities, he seeks for you aid.

source: Vous avez croisé une chercheuse étrange qui tente de parler à des chats via une fonction spéciale de sa borne...
target: A strange researcher is trying to talk to cats through a special function of her Terminal...

source: Vous avez décidé de rester en arrière à la fin de ce récit, plaçant votre espoir en Lupa.
target: In the final moments, you decide to leave Lupa with the seed of hope.

source: Vous avez découvert d'étranges statues dans les Plaines Dimmr. Elles semblent garder un lourd secret...
target: You've found some peculiar statues in the Dimmr Plains. They seem to be guarding a hidden secret...

source: Vous avez découvert une moto d'expédition dans le défilé de glace... Trouvez un moyen de la ramener à la Voie céleste.
target: You've discovered an expedition motorbike in the ice gorge... Find a way to bring it back to the Starward Riseway.

source: Vous avez entendu un appel au secours à proximité du Port de la ville Guixu et il paraît que vous vous souvenez de cette voix...Allons vérifier ce qui s'est passé.
target: Intermittent cries for help can be heard from the Port City of Guixu. They sound oddly familiar. It's best to go check out what's happening.

source: Vous avez investi dans la fondation dont Jianji a parlé, mais verrez-vous vraiment les retours qu'il a promis ?
target: You've invested in the foundation Jianji spoke of, but will you really see the returns he promised?

source: Vous avez obtenu un objet étrange de Chenpi, qui a laissé entendre que c'était la clé d'un secret oublié depuis longtemps.
target: You obtained a strange object from Chenpi, who implied it was a key to a long-forgotten secret.

source: Vous avez obtenu un véhicule. Suivez les instructions du Canal de Marée jusqu'à la Borne d'entraînement pour terminer le tutoriel.
target: You've obtained a vehicle. Please follow the WavesLine instructions and go to the Training Terminal to complete vehicle driving tutorial.

source: Vous avez obtenu une photo du monde d'une peinture transmutatrice. Cela révèle une histoire du passé....
target: You retrieved a photo from the sphere inside the morph painting, which reveals clues to a hidden past...

source: Vous avez percé le secret des trois jetons, mais leurs réponses restent cachées derrière une porte énigmatique, révélée par les indices du cadran solaire.
target: You have discovered the three tokens' purpose and directions, but the answers to their riddles are hidden behind a mysterious entrance, which you found with help from the Sundial's hints.

source: Vous avez refusé d'aider Zhenliu, mais vous avez tout de même accepté de livrer le colis et la liste à leur destination. Allez trouver le destinataire.
target: You declined to help Zhenliu, but still agreed to deliver the package and the list to their destination. Go find the recipient.

source: Vous avez remis un trésor trouvé chez un enfant à S.I.R.E.N.E., et l'analyse a révélé qu'il était lié à un professeur disparu de l'académie. Vous décidez alors de lancer une enquête.
target: You hand the “treasure” taken from the kids to I.R.I.S. The system analysis reveals it's connected to a missing professor. You decide to look deeper.

source: Vous avez rencontré Bjarki, un élève très gentil. Suite à ses recommandations chaleureuses, vous vous intéressez aux différents clubs de l'académie.
target: You meet an enthusiastic student named Bjarki. Thanks to his recommendations, you find yourself intrigued by all the different "fan clubs" across the Academy…

source: Vous avez rencontré la gladiatrice Lupa à Septimont.
target: You cross paths with Gladiator Lupa in Septimont.

source: Vous avez reçu un autre message de Jingran ; allez découvrir l'histoire de l'Abyssomancien avec lui.
target: A WavesLine message has come in from Jingran. Go with him and get to the bottom of this old Nethermancer story.

source: Vous avez reçu un boulot d'un client de Jinzhou... à Ragunna, le prix de Farine 50% moins cher de celui à Jinzhou ?!
target: You received an errand from Jinzhou. What? Flour in Ragunna only costs half as much as in Jinzhou?!

source: Vous avez reçu un message d'Encore, elle a dit qu'elle avait quelque chose de « super amusant et génial » à partager avec vous, mais... qu'est-ce que c'est ?
target: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

source: Vous avez reçu un message de Fulmine. Un membre de l'équipe de peluches est arrivé aux Septimonts de manière étrange...
target: In Septimont, you received a message from Fulmine: A tiny plushie expedition squad from Ragunna has somehow arrived here too…

source: Vous avez reçu un message de Luuk Herssen. Il souhaite vous retrouver pour vous raconter comment se porte le petit fugitif ces derniers temps.
target: Luuk Herssen sends you a WavesLine message. He wants to meet and tell you how the cat has been doing lately.

source: Vous avez reçu un message de M. Fulmine. Il parle de « clients » mystérieux qui refusent de révéler leur nom et l'invitent à vous confier une demande.
target: You receive a call from Fulmine, who was asked by a few mysterious "people" to send you an invitation...

source: Vous avez reçu un message de « Horizons Lumineux », un contact inconnu, qui vous invite à participer à l'activité du club pour créer un album...
target: A WavesLine message arrives from a strange account named "Lightborne Horizons." With almost contagious enthusiasm, the sender invites you to join a photography event called "Light Chaser Collection"…

source: Vous avez reçu un message des Concierges, quelque chose a dû se passer avec le Somnoire.
target: You received a contact from the Ivory and Ebony Gatekeepers. Something must've happened with the Somnoire.

source: Vous avez reçu un message du chat blanc du Somnoire. Parlez avec lui à la ville de Ragunna.
target: You received a message from the white cat of the Somnoire. Go talk to it in Ragunna City.

source: Vous avez reçu un message du repaire du chasseur : on vous invite à examiner les traces des Tacets Discords et à les retrouver.
target: You receive a new message from the Hunter's Den: Please examine the traces left by TDs and track them down.

source: Vous avez reçu un message qui appelle à l'aide, allez voir ce qui s'est passé.
target: You receive a WavesLine message asking for help. Check what it's about.

source: Vous avez reçu un message qui vous a été envoyé par erreur : Ronan, l'expéditeur, dit qu'il a découvert l'« évolution miracle d'un Couronuage » et vous invite à en témoigner ensemble...
target: You receive a mis-sent message: Ronan claims to have witnessed the "miraculous evolution of a Kronapuff" and excitedly invites you to see it…

source: Vous avez reçu un message. Allez parler à Langsheng
target: You received a message. Talk to Langsheng.

source: Vous avez reçu une brochure énigmatique de l'Association Pionnière. Rendez-vous à leur antenne de Jinzhou et parlez à Maqi pour en savoir plus.
target: You receive a Pioneer Association Leaflet in your mailbox. Go to Jinzhou Branch and ask Maqi what has happened.

source: Vous avez reçu une lettre d'invitation de la part de Wenshu. Elle indique que les Jeux de la Rivière de Jinzhou auront lieu prochainement. Veuillez vous rendre aux coordonnées indiquées pour y jeter un œil.
target: You have received an invitation letter from Wenshu. It mentions that the"Jinzhou Riverside Games" will be held soon. Go to the coordinates enclosed in the letter and have a look.

source: Vous avez reçu une étrange invitation à une Fête de tir, apparemment liée au robot endommagé au Pic de Résoudre. Allez vérifier sur place.
target: You've received an invitation to a peculiar shooting party, seemingly related to the damaged robot in Settle Range. Go check it out.

source: Vous avez récupéré plusieurs antiquités appelées « Boîtes de Sonance » dans la ville de Jinzhou. Elles semblent intéresser Chenpi, le marchand d'antiquités local. Vous devriez peut-être aller lui en parler.
target: You've collected some "Sonance Caskets". It seems to fall in the interest of the local Relic Merchant Chenpi.

source: Vous avez sauvé de nombreux chats errants. Veuillez rencontrer Xiaoju pour voir comment ils vont.
target: You've rescued many stray cats. Please go to Xiaoju's Restaurant to see how they are doing.

source: Vous avez sauvé un Mime Aria de la banlieue de Septimont et il vous a confié quatre boîtes musicales. Chacune d'elles renferme une mélodie unique, mais quelle histoire racontent-elles ?
target: You rescued a weak Aria Mummer near Septimont City. It entrusts you with four Melody Boxes, each carrying a piece of music. What story might they tell?

source: Vous avez trouvé des indices et il est temps de partir pour retrouver le mécha perdu.
target: You've located the missing patrol mech. Head into the wilderness and retrieve it.

source: Vous avez trouvé un enregistrement. Le vent hurle à vos oreilles, porteur de murmures. Peut-être que le robot tout proche détient la clé de la suite de l'histoire.
target: You've picked up a recording. The wind is howling in your ears, carrying the whispers. Perhaps, the robot nearby holds the key to unravel the continuation of the story.

source: Vous avez un nouveau message d'un contact inconnu
target: You received a WavesLine message from an unknown sender

source: Vous avez une nouvelle commande de Loulou Hitman. Veuillez la traiter à temps.
target: You have a new "Lollo Hitman" order. Please fulfill it in time.

source: Vous avez une nouvelle commande « Loulou Accueillant ». Veuillez l'accomplir à temps.
target: You have a new "Lollo Take-in" order. Please fulfill it in time.

source: Vous avez une nouvelle commande « Loulou Courses ». Veuillez la remplir à temps.
target: You have a new "Lollo Grocery Shopping" order. Please fulfill it in time.

source: Vous avez une nouvelle commande « Loulou Câlin ». Veuillez l'accomplir à temps.
target: You have a new "Lollo Petter" order. Please fulfill it in time.

source: Vous avez une nouvelle commande « Loulou Mangeur ». Veuillez l'accomplir à temps.
target: You have a new "Lollo Eater" order. Please fulfill it in time.

source: Vous avez une nouvelle commande « Loulou Réparateur ». Veuillez la remplir à temps.
target: You have a new "Lollo Fixit" order. Please fulfill it in time.

source: Vous croisez Jingran d'une manière inattendue et il découvre une anecdote de l'Abyssomancien.
target: You cross paths with Jingran again by chance, and he seems to have stumbled onto an old story involving the Nethermancers.

source: Vous croisez Lynae dans la Salle de projection. A-t-elle… sauté des cours à nouveau ? Peut-être devriez-vous lui demander vous-même.
target: You run into Lynae in the Screening Room. Did she… skip classes again? Maybe you should ask her yourself.

source: Vous croisez des enfants qui jouent à cache-cache et ils vous disent que vous recevrez un « trésor » en récompense si vous parvenez à trouver tout le monde. Vous décidez alors de...
target: You come across kids playing hide-and-seek. They promise you their “treasure” if you can find all of them within the time limit…

source: Vous croisez un chercheur aux abois, désespérément à la recherche d'unités TARD-E égarées au cœur des Plaines Dimmr.
target: You encounter an anxious researcher who is searching for a batch of lost TARD-Es in the Dimmr Plains...

source: Vous croisez un marchand étrange et passionnant de la tribu Royanne à la Station Relais, et il vous invite à participer à une transaction...
target: A strange Royan merchant arrives near the Relay Station, unusually warm and eager to involve you in an odd transaction…

source: Vous croisez une chercheuse anxieuse qui sollicite votre aide pour chasser les Hoolices.
target: You encountered an anxious researcher, who requests your help to fight off the Hoochiefs.

source: Vous percevez un regard timide dans un coin du restaurant de Margherita. Passez jeter un coup d'œil quand vous en aurez l'occasion.
target: A pair of cautious eyes from the corner of Margherita's restaurant seem to call for your attention. Drop by and take a look when you have the chance.

source: Vous recevez un message de Jingran à minuit. Il dit qu'il a trouvé un indice lié à l'objet détruit et vous invite à l'examiner ensemble.
target: Late at night, a WavesLine message arrives from Jingran. He's found a lead on that damaged item from before and is inviting you over to take a look.

source: Vous recevez un message urgent de l'Académie de Huaxu demandant un soutien d'urgence. Rendez-vous sur le lieu indiqué pour en savoir plus.
target: You receive an urgent message from Huaxu Academy for emergency support. Head to the designated location for more information.

source: Vous recroisez Maji. Tout juste sorti du siège de Loulou Logistique, il semble déterminé à relancer le Projet Loulou.
target: You cross paths with Maji once more. Fresh from the Lollo Logistics Headquarters, he appears determined to relaunch the Lollo Campaign.

source: Vous remarquez que la barrière qui empêche le Sabot-de-fer ne semble pas être faite de la technologie des royans. Cela paraît suspect...
target: The Lightbeam Fencing restraining the rampaging Ironhoof doesn't seem like Royan tech, which captures your attention...

source: Vous rencontrez un robot inhabituel qui semble avoir une vue assez unique de la vérité derrière ce monde...
target: You encounter an unusual robot who seems to hold a rather unique view of the truth behind this world...

source: Vous rencontrez un vieux conteur lors de votre séjour à Hongzhen. Tout en écoutant les légendes d'immortalité du Mont Firmament, vous remarquez un autre auditeur intéressé...
target: You meet an old storyteller when you roam about in Hongzhen. While you listen to the the immortality tales about Mt. Firmament, you notice another interested listener...

source: Vous rencontrez à nouveau Xiangli Yao sous l'Arbre à vœux. Cependant, cette fois vous partagez une promenade non pour les vœux des autres mais pour la gloire de la lune et la vie animée des gens.
target: You meet Xiangli Yao again under the Wishing Tree. Yet, this time you share a walk not for others' wishes but for the moon's glory and the bustling lives of people.

source: Vous rencontrez à nouveau Xuanyin et elle est en train de jouer avec les chiens…
target: You meet Xuanyin again, who is having fun with some puppies...

source: Vous rencontrez à nouveau Xuanyin qui essaie de parler à une mouette grise...
target: You meet Xuanyin again. This time, she is trying to talk to a Gray Crested Gull...

source: Vous rencontrez à nouveau Xuanyin, elle observe un lapin vert...
target: You meet Xuanyin again. This time, she is spying on a Green Rabbit...

source: Vous rencontrez à nouveau Xuanyin, entourée de coassements de grenouilles...
target: You meet Xuanyin again, while the sounds of frog surround you...

source: Vous rencontrez à nouveau Xuanyin. Cette fois, elle observe les Tetras...
target: You meet Xuanyin again. This time, she is spying on the Tetra...

source: Vous rencontrez à nouveau Xuanyin. Cette fois, elle observe les pigeons sur le toit…
target: You meet Xuanyin again. This time, she is observing the doves on the rooftop...

source: Vous retrouvez Xuanyin, absorbée par une pensée douloureuse...
target: You meet Xuanyin again, who was buried in thoughts...

source: Vous revenez à Ragunna pour voir si les conséquences du Fabricatorium des Profondeurs ont affecté les habitants, et vous tombez sur Zani en ville. Partagez vos informations avec elle.
target: You return to Ragunna to see whether the aftermath of the Fabricatorium of the Deep reached the people there, but unexpectedly run into Zani in the city. Might as well talk to her to catch up with the situation.

source: Vous sauvez Jianji et découvrez que toute l'affaire était l'œuvre d'exilés qui s'étaient infiltrés dans la Cité de Xuanfang. Vous récupérez les fonds et, avec l'aide du Ministère des Affaires étrangères de Xuanfang, les restituez aux victimes.
target: You rescue Jianji and discover the whole affair was the work of Exiles who had slipped into Xuanfang Hold. You recover the funds and, with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' help, return them to the victims.

source: Vous tombez sur une hologramme laissé par un chercheur. Il semble vous inviter à essayer son « chef-d'œuvre » dont il est si fier.
target: You come across a hologram left behind by a researcher. It seems he's inviting you to try out the "masterpiece" he's so proud of.

source: Vous trouvez une « petite lueur » mystérieuse. Suivez-la et vous découvrez, peut-être, la flambée des étoiles filantes.
target: You find a mysterious "light spark." Follow this little spark, and you may witness the shooting stars blaze.

source: Vous trouvez une « petite lueur » mystérieuse. Suivez-la et vous découvrez, peut-être, la flambée des étoiles filantes.
target: You find a mysterious "light spark." Follow this little spark, and you might witness the shooting stars blaze.

source: Vous trouvez une « petite lueur » mystérieuse. Suivez-la et vous découvrez, peut-être, la flambée des étoiles filantes.
target: You find a mysterious "light spark." Follow this little spark, and you may witness the shooting stars blaze.

source: Vous vous impliquez dans le projet de reconstruction de l'Observatoire Trek-spatial en aidant à reconstruire le réseau de routes de Lahai-Roi.
target: You get involved in the reconstruction project of the Spacetrek Observatory by helping rebuild Lahai-Roi's route network.

source: Vous vous retrouvez pris dans un pari entre Brant et l'équipage, et avant que vous ne puissiez protester, le titre de capitaine d'un jour de la Troupe des Fous vous est imposé. Êtes-vous prêt, Capitaine ? L'aventure vous attend !
target:
You find yourself caught in a gamble between Brant and the crew, and before you can protest, the title of one-day captain of the Fool's Troupe is thrust upon you.
Are you ready, Captain? Adventure awaits!

source: Vous voyez Panhua consoler une fille qui pleure. Peut-être pourriez-vous demander ce qui s'est passé...
target: You see Panhua comforting a crying girl. Maybe go up and ask what happened...

source: Vous êtes au-dessus des nuages avec les peluches ! Découvrez les paysages admirables avec eux.
target: You and the plushies journey above the clouds, where a world of wonder awaits your discovery.

source: Vous êtes désormais un expert dans la recherche des résidus. Il est temps de partir à la découverte des nouvelles surprises que vous réserve la ville de Honami…
target: You're now an expert in finding castaway objects. What new and curious discoveries await you in Honami City?

source: Vovô Jingzhu desenvolveu um novo método para treinar Ecos. Vá e pergunte a ele sobre os detalhes.
target: Grandpa Jingzhu has come up with a new method to train Echoes. Go and ask him about the details.

source: Vovô Jingzhu finalmente revela o segredo supremo para treinar Ecos…! Será que ele finalmente conseguirá o que quer desta vez?
target: Grandpa Jingzhu finally reveals the ultimate secret to training Echoes...! Will he finally get what he wants this time?

source: Voyage au bord du ciel
target: Skyward Voyage

source: Voyage au bord du ciel : Suite
target: Skyward Voyage: Epilogue

source: Voyage de fin d'études
target: Graduation Trip

source: Voyage à Jinzhou : Gulboule
target: Travel in Jinzhou: Gulpuffs

source: Voz de Materia de Vacío
target: Sound of Voidmatter

source: Vá Pescar
target: Go Get Some Fish

source: Vá ao laboratório e procure as pistas deixadas pelo mecha de patrulha desaparecido com Lynae.
target: Head to the lab and look for the clues left by the missing patrol mech with Lynae.

source: Vá até Maji e verifique se há novas tarefas.
target: Go to Maji's place and check for new errands.

source: Vá até o local da Celebração e investigue o mecha de patrulha protótipo desaparecido com Lynae.
target: Head to the Celebration venue and investigate the missing prototype patrol mech with Lynae.

source: Vá para a Cidade de Ragunna
target: Head to Ragunna City

source: Vá para a câmara mais profunda da câmara para localizar o "impostor" e encontre uma forma de sair.
target: Proceed to the vault's deepest chamber to locate the "imposter" and find a way to leave.

source: Vários novos recrutas do Guarda de Xuanfang estão passando por treinamento em coordenação de combate com Maquinetes. Vá ver o que está acontecendo.
target: Several new Xuanfang Warden recruits are undergoing training in combat coordination with Autopuppets. Go see what's happening.

source: Vérifier le Camion de Loulou Logistique. Obtenir l'information concernant l'événement de collaboration avec l'Association pionnière.
target: The Pioneer Association and Lollo Logistics introduced another joint campaign. Go check it out over at the Lollo Logistics Truck.

source: Véus Removidos ao Sol ou à Sombra
target: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow

source: Wache der Endlosen Nacht
target: Vigil of Endless Night

source: Waffel-Therapie
target: Waffle Therapy

source: Wahre Farben
target: True Colors

source: Wahrheiten, Antworten und Wahlen verstecken sich im umgekehrten Turm
target: Truths, answers, and choices lie at the heart of the Inverted Tower.

target: Farer's Road

source: Wanne Welpe
target: Tubpup

source: Warte auf Godo
target: Wait for Godo

source: Warum besteht Großvater Jingzhu darauf, Echos zu fangen? Triff dich mit Chixia und hilf Großvater Jingzhu zusammen.
target: Why does Grandpa Jingzhu insist on capturing Echoes? Go meet up with Chixia and help Grandpa Jingzhu together.

source: Was gestern weinte, singt heute in Freude
target: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing

target: What Burns Beneath Frostlands

target: WavesLine Insider

target: WavesLine Insider

target: WavesLine Insider

target: Pastures Like Old Times

source: Weining a envoyé un message étrange. Selon elle, on vous a « kidnappé » ! Que se passe-t-il ?
target: Weining sent a strange message. According to her, you've been "kidnapped" by someone right now. What on earth is going on?

source: Weining enviou uma mensagem estranha. Segundo ela, você foi "sequestrado" por alguém agora mesmo. O que diabos está acontecendo?
target: Weining sent a strange message. According to her, you've been "kidnapped" by someone right now. What on earth is going on?

source: Weining envió un mensaje extraño. Según ella, has sido «secuestrado» por alguien en este momento. ¿Qué diablos está pasando?
target: Weining sent a strange message. According to her, you've been "kidnapped" by someone right now. What on earth is going on?

source: Weining hat eine seltsame WavesLine geschickt. Ihren Worten zufolge solltest du im Augenblick von einigen Leuten „entführt“ worden sein … Was ist hier nur los?
target: Weining sent a strange message. According to her, you've been "kidnapped" by someone right now. What on earth is going on?

source: Weining ส่งข้อความแปลกๆ มาหาคุณ ตามที่เธอบอก ตอนนี้คุณน่าจะถูกใครบางคน "ลักพาตัว" ไป... นี่มันเรื่องอะไรกันแน่?
target: Weining sent a strange message. According to her, you've been "kidnapped" by someone right now. What on earth is going on?

source: Weiyang e Changwen parecem estar filmando novas imagens, e o assunto parece ser uma batalha em Xuanfang muitos anos atrás...
target: Weiyang and Changwen seem to be filming new footage, and the subject appears to be a battle in Xuanfang Hold many years ago...

source: Weiyang et Changwen semblent tourner de nouvelles séquences, et le sujet semble être une bataille dans la Cité de Xuanfang il y a de nombreuses années...
target: Weiyang and Changwen seem to be filming new footage, and the subject appears to be a battle in Xuanfang Hold many years ago...

source: Weiyang und Changwen scheinen neues Filmmaterial aufzunehmen, dessen Inhalt offenbar mit dem Kampf in der Xuanfang-Feste vor vielen Jahren zu tun hat …
target: Weiyang and Changwen seem to be filming new footage, and the subject appears to be a battle in Xuanfang Hold many years ago...

source: Weiyang y Changwen parecen estar grabando nuevas imágenes, y el tema parece ser una batalla en la Fortaleza Xuanfang hace muchos años...
target: Weiyang and Changwen seem to be filming new footage, and the subject appears to be a battle in Xuanfang Hold many years ago...

source: Weiß noch nicht, ob es Jingran schon besser geht. Sieh nach ihm.
target: There's no telling whether Jingran is doing any better. Go pay him a visit.

source: Weltrettung? Rettung der Katzen!
target: Save the World? Save the Cat!

source: Wenchang bereitet derzeit das erste interaktive Live-Action-Tourismusprojekt im Xuanfang-Territorium vor. Wenn du Interesse hast, geh hin und erlebe es selbst.
target: Wenchang is currently preparing the first live-action interactive tourism project in the Land of Xuanfang. If you're interested, head on over and experience it firsthand.

source: Wenchang está atualmente preparando o primeiro projeto de turismo interativo de ação ao vivo na Terra de Xuanfang. Se estiver interessado, vá até lá e experimente em primeira mão.
target: Wenchang is currently preparing the first live-action interactive tourism project in the Land of Xuanfang. If you're interested, head on over and experience it firsthand.

source: Wenchang está preparando un proyecto de turismo interactivo en la tierra de Xuanfang. Si te interesa, puedes ir a probarlo.
target: Wenchang is currently preparing the first live-action interactive tourism project in the Land of Xuanfang. If you're interested, head on over and experience it firsthand.

source: Wenchang prépare le tout premier projet touristique interactif des Terres de Xuanfang. Si cela vous intéresse, allez le découvrir sur place.
target: Wenchang is currently preparing the first live-action interactive tourism project in the Land of Xuanfang. If you're interested, head on over and experience it firsthand.

target: Wenchang is currently preparing the first live-action interactive tourism project in the Land of Xuanfang. If you're interested, head on over and experience it firsthand.

target: When Moonlight Shines in the Forest

target: If Dreams Still Reverberate

source: Wenn Träume noch widerhallen: Epilog
target: If Dreams Still Reverberate - Epilogue

source: Wenn das Bekannte pulst!
target: When the Known Thrums!

source: Wenn das Unbekannte pulst
target: When the Unknown Thrums

source: Wenn der Sieg kommt, küssen die Blätter des Ruhms die Stirn des Kriegers.
target: When victory arrives, the branches of glory bend to kiss the warrior's forehead.

source: Wenn der Wald nicht mehr dunkel ist
target: When the Forest is No Longer Dim
